samples.ref: For contrast, the model was assessed first under the assumption that asymptomatic individuals are equally as infectious as symptomatic individuals and then secondly, and more likely, assuming asymptomatic individuals are only half as infectious as symptomatic individuals.

samples.ref: For 50% asymptomatic, minimum blanket testing rates of ≥ 4540 tests/ 100000 population was sufficient to control the outbreak at both assumed levels of infectiousness for asymptomatic individuals relative to symptomatic individuals.

samples.ref: Because the characteristics of COVID-19 seemed to vary from place to place, they looked at 4 scenarios, where either 50% or 70% of COVID-19 cases were asymptomatic, and these cases were either equally or half as infectious as symptomatic ones.

samples.ref: The researchers’ model found that it was possible to control the spread of COVID-19 by performing blanket tests and by isolating all people who tested positive, even those without symptoms.

samples.ref: They also found that if we wanted to keep the number of new COVID-19 infections constant, 22% of people needed to be tested every day.

Ngokwesibonelo, ukugoma kungasetshenziswa ukuhlanganiswa nezinye izindlela zokuqapha, njengokuhlola ukuthi abantu abathintekayo banazo yini izimpawu. Lokhu kungasiza ukuthola ngokushesha abantu abathintekayo futhi kubavikele ukuthi bangasabalalisi igciwane.

samples.src: Ukujwayelekelisa okuphansi kwamaphuzu enxubefuzo kubantu base-Afrika ngenxa yokuhlukahluka kofuzo kanye nemvelo
samples.ref: Low generalizability of polygenic scores in African populations due to genetic and environmental diversity
samples.hyp: yezempilo. Ukuhlolwa okwengeziwe okubanzi kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okutholwe kule mininingwane kungafaneleki kubantu base-Afrika.

samples.src: Izibalo zabantu base-Afrika zimelwe kancane kakhulu ezifundweni zofuzo kodwa zinokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo futhi zibhekene nokuchayeka okubanzi kwemvelo emhlabeni jikelele.
samples.ref: African populations are vastly underrepresented in genetic studies but have the most genetic variation and face wide-ranging environmental exposures globally.

samples.src: Ngenxa yokuthi ukuhlolwa okuhlelekile kokubikezelwa kofuzo bekungakenziwa kokhokho abahlanganisa ukuhlukahluka kwe-Afrika, sibale amaphuzu engozi yenxubefuzo (PRS) ekulingiseni e-Afrika yonkana kanye nakwingcobelelo yobufakazi evela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuze siqonde kangcono ukutholakala kofuzo jikelele. izifundo.
samples.ref: Because systematic evaluations of genetic prediction had not yet been conducted in ancestries that span African diversity, we calculated polygenic risk scores (PRS) in simulations across Africa and in empirical data from South Africa, Uganda, and the UK to better understand the generalizability of genetic studies.

samples.src: Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyathuthuka ngamaqoqo okutholwa okufaniswa nokhokho ngaphezu kokusuka ezifundweni ezingafani zokhokho.
samples.ref: PRS accuracy improves with ancestry-matched discovery cohorts more than from ancestry-mismatched studies.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwezimpahla zokuhlaziya zokuhlaziya, ukuhlaziya kwezimpahla zokuhlaziya, kanye nokuhlaziya kwezimpahla zokuhlaziya.

samples.src: Kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abangokhokho nabahlukene ngokwezizwe, sithola ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izici kodwa kuyehluka ngamaqembu.
samples.ref: Within ancestrally and ethnically diverse South Africans, we find that PRS accuracy is low for all traits but varies across groups.
samples.hyp: Ukuhluka okukhulu kutholakala phakathi kwamaqembu aseNingizimu Afrika aseNyakatho kanye nalawa aseNingizimu.

samples.src: Umehluko kokhokho base-Afrika unomthelela omkhulu ekuhlukeni kokunemba kwe-PRS kunomunye umehluko omkhulu weqembu ocatshangwayo phakathi kwabantu base-UK uma beqhathaniswa ne-Uganda.
samples.ref: Differences in African ancestries contribute more to variability in PRS accuracy than other large cohort differences considered between individuals in the UK versus Uganda.

samples.src: Senze ikhompuyutha i-PRS kubantu base-Afrika sisebenzisa izifundo zofuzo ezikhona zase-Europe kuphela uma kuqhathaniswa nezasemandulo; ukuhlukahluka okwandayo kukhiqize izinzuzo zokunemba ezinkulu kakhulu zokugxiliswa kwehemogilobhini kanye nokubalwa kwamangqamuzana amhlophe egazi, okubonisa ukuhlukahluka okunothisiwe kokhokho ezakhini zofuzo ezaziwa ngokuthelela amemiya yesikela kanye nokuphendula okunqabayo, ngokulandelana.
samples.ref: We computed PRS in African ancestry populations using existing European-only versus ancestrally diverse genetic studies; the increased diversity produced the largest accuracy gains for hemoglobin concentration and white blood cell count, reflecting large-effect ancestry-enriched variants in genes known to influence sickle cell anemia and the allergic response, respectively.

samples.src: Umehluko ekunembeni kwe-PRS kubo bonke okhokho base-Afrika asuka ezifundeni ezihlukahlukene mkhulu njengabo bonke okhokho angaphandle kwe-Afrika, okudinga ukuhluka okulinganayo.
samples.ref: Differences in PRS accuracy across African ancestries originating from diverse regions are as large as across out-of-Africa continental ancestries, requiring commensurate nuance.

samples.src: Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile izifo zofuzo kubantu bendabuko base-Afrika
samples.ref: Why we can’t accurately predict genetic diseases in people of African ancestry

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi izindlela zamanje ezisetshenziswayo ukubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika.
samples.ref: Researchers say that current methods used to predict whether or not a person will develop a genetic disease doesn’t work well for people of African origin.

samples.src: Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isizindalwazi esilandela lezi zibikezelo ngokuvamile sichaza izakhi zofuzo zabantu bomdabu wase-Europe.
samples.ref: This is because the database behind such predictions mostly describes genes of people of European origin.

samples.src: Isizindalwazi se-GWAS simele ukuthi “Genome-Wide Association Studies”, futhi ososayensi basisebenzisa ukuze babheke izici nezifo ezisekelwe kufuzo.
samples.ref: The GWAS database stands for “Genome-Wide Association Studies”, and scientists use it to look for traits and diseases based on genes.

samples.src: Eqinisweni, bangasebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ubungozi bofuzo bomuntu ngesifo noma isici.
samples.ref: In fact, they can use the GWAS to calculate a person’s genetic risk for a disease or trait.

samples.src: Iningi lengcobelelo yofuzo ku-GWAS, nokho, livela kubantu bokhokho baseYurophu.
samples.ref: Most of the gene data in GWAS, however, comes from people of European ancestry.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa kwe-GWAS okwengeziwe kufanele kwenziwe ezinhlelweni zefuzo ezihlukile ukuze kutholakale ukuthi ukuguqulwa okufanayo kusebenza kanjani ezinhlelweni ezihlukene.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukubona ukuthi izibalo abazisebenzisayo ukuze bathole ingozi yezifo zofuzo ngokusebenzisa i-GWAS iyabesebenzela abantu bomdabu base-Afrika.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to see how well the calculation they use to determine genetic disease risk using GWAS works for people of African ancestry.
samples.hyp: I-GWAS, noma ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana kwemajini, kungumkhuba ovamile wokuhlaziya idatha yomjikelezo ukuze uthole ukuhambisana okunamandla phakathi kwamajini kanye nezifo. Kodwa-ke, ukusetshenziswa kwe-GWAS ezilawini zase-Afrika kuye kwaba nomthelela kakhulu ngenxa yokuphakama kokuhlukahluka kwemajini kanye nokuthi imijikelezo yama-Afrika ayihambisani kakhulu nemijikelezo eyisisekelo ebandakanywe kwi-GWAS.

samples.src: Baphinde bafuna ukubona ukuthi i-GWAS ehluke kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi isizindalwazi esihlanganisa ulwazi olwengeziwe lofuzo lwase-Afrika, ingathuthukisa ukubikezela.
samples.ref: They also wanted to see if a more diverse GWAS, in other words a database that includes more African genetic information, would improve the predictions.

samples.src: Isibalo saziwa ngamagama esayensi kakhulu ngokuthi “Amaphuzu Obungozi Bengxubefuzo”, noma i-PRS.
samples.ref: The calculation is known in more scientific terms as the “polygenic risk score”, or PRS.
samples.hyp: I-PRS yindlela yokuhlaziya ukuthi umuntu uyisiphi isilinganiso somtholampilo esingaba khona ngempela. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlaziya ulwazi lwe-genomic lomuntu, kanye nemininingwane yezempilo.

samples.src: Basebenzisa amakhompiyutha ukubala izingozi zofuzo ezazibikezelwe zabantu base-Afrika besebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzisa amarekhodi ezokwelapha abantu base-Afrika ukuze babheke izici ezithile noma izifo okungenzeka zidalwe ukushintsha kwezakhi zofuzo.
samples.ref: They used computers to calculate the predicted genetic risks of the African population using the GWAS, and they used medical records of African people to look at certain traits or diseases that might have been caused by changes in genes.

samples.src: Lapho besebenzisa i-GWAS yaseYurophu, bathola ukuthi amaphuzu engozi yofuzo ayenembe kakhulu uma abantu benomdabu waseYurophu lapho kuqhathaniswa nabomdabu base-Afrika ngezici eziningi.
samples.ref: When they used the European GWAS, they found that the genetic risk score was more accurate if people had European ancestry compared to African ancestry for most traits.

samples.src: Bathe amanani ezingozi mancane kakhulu phakathi kwezifunda zase-Afrika ngoba kunokuhlukahlukana kwabantu, okungahambisani nalokho esikubona kwabomdabu base-Europe.
samples.ref: They said that the risk scores are quite low between African regions because there is so much diversity amongst the population, which is not in line with what we see for European ancestry.

samples.src: Baphinde bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyanda njengoba imvelaphi yase-Afrika iyancipha.
samples.ref: They also said PRS accuracy increases as the African origin decreases.

samples.src: Balinganiselwa kwaba-851 340 abesifazane base-Namibia abasengcupheni yokutheleleka nge-human papilloma viral (HPV) engase ibangele umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.
samples.ref: An estimated 851 340 women in Namibia are at risk of human papilloma viral (HPV) infection that may cause cervical cancer.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kubalwa kulinganiselwe kwabafana abangama-270 000 abangama-9 ukuya kwangu-14 ubudala abangase bathinteke yilezi zigciwane. Ukutholakala kwe-HPV kubalwa njengokuthi cishe u-10% wabafana nabesifazane abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya kwangu-14.

samples.src: Ukuhlolwa okubonakalayo nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kuhlolwe ukuthi kusebenza kahle kakhulu.
samples.ref: Visual screening with acetic acid (VIA) and cryotherapy have been proven highly effective.

samples.ref: This study evaluated visual and cytology screening in preventing cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) and cervical cancer in Namibia.

samples.ref: Findings showed that women with HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis and atypia are at an increased risk of testing positive for VIA.

samples.src: Abesifazane asebekhulile, ikakhulukazi abane-HIV maningi amathuba okuthi batholakale bene-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
samples.ref: Older women, particularly with HIV are more likely to be diagnosed with squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

Ngakho-ke, ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV okuhlanganisiwe okuhloswe ukuhlonza abesifazane abanezinkinga ezinkulu zokutholakala kwe-SCC kungaba yindlela ekhuthulayo.

samples.src: Inqubo ye-VIA ibonakala isebenza ekuhlolweni, nakuba i-colposcopy ekulandeleni isiguli esimweni sase-Namibia kufanele ibuyekezwe futhi isetshenziswe ngemiphumela emihle ye-HR-HPV.
samples.ref: VIA procedure seems to be viable in screening, although colposcopy in patient follow-up in the Namibian context should be revised and used with positive HR-HPV results.

samples.src: Izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolelwa i-HPV ubudala obuhlukahlukene kanye nenani labantu abasengozini (isb. ukuba ne-HIV, isifo sokuzivikela komzimba) kuyanconywa.
samples.ref: Screening modalities incorporating HPV testing for different ages and risk populations (e.g. HIV positive, autoimmune disease) is recommended.

samples.src: Ukusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kungathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo ngokungenelela okusebenzisa imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yangaphambilini yokuxilonga, izinhloso zezempilo zabesifazane, ulwazi lwakamuva kanye nokwenza okufanele kumongo kazwelonke.
samples.ref: Screening uptake can further be improved by interventions that adopt a model which uses previous diagnostic outcomes, women’s health objectives, up-to-date knowledge and practice relevant to national context.

samples.src: Abesifazane base-Namibia abasengozini yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi belashwe kusenesikhathi
samples.ref: Namibian women at risk for cervical cancer should be tested and treated earlier

samples.src: Ukuhlola okuningi kungabonisa ingozi yabesifazane yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, kodwa ukuhlola okuvamile e-Namibia akusebenzisi njalo lokhu kuhlola.
samples.ref: Many tests can show women’s risk for cervical cancer, but routine check-ups in Namibia don’t always use these tests.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuhlola okuvamile, ukuze kutholakale izimpawu eziyisixwayiso kusenesikhathi, kungavimbela abesifazane ekubeni babe nalesi sifo esibulalayo.
samples.ref: Researchers suggest regular testing, to find warning signs earlier, could prevent women from developing this deadly disease.

samples.src: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho (umdlavuza wengxenye engezansi yesibeletho) ubangela ukufa kwabantu abaningi kwabesifazane emhlabeni wonke.
samples.ref: Cervical cancer (cancer of the lower section of the womb) causes many deaths among women world-wide.
samples.hyp: Ukutholakala kwesikhathi eside kanye nokwelashwa okuyisikhathi eside kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukeni kobufuzo. Ngakho-ke, ukutholakala kwesikhathi esikhudululwe kanye nokwelashwa okuyisikhathi esikhudululwe kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukeni kobufuzo.

samples.src: Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
samples.ref: One of the most common causes of cervical cancer is Human Papillomavirus, or HPV.
samples.hyp: I-HPV iyinto engokomoya eyayilwa ukuhlala emzimbeni, kodwa ingadala ama-wart, kanye neminye imikhuba emibi. I-HPV ibhekene nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, ikakhulukazi emdlavuzeni wesibeletho esiphakathi. Ukutholakala kwe-HPV kungahlaziywa ngokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA.

samples.src: I-HPV igciwane elilimaza imithambo yesibeletho, lakhe izilonda ezibizwa ngokuthi i-leisons, ezingagcina zibe nomdlavuza.
samples.ref: HPV is a virus that damages the cells of the womb, forming wounds called lesions, which can eventually become cancerous.
samples.hyp: Ukutholakala kwe-HPV kulondoloza ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuhlaziywa kwe-PCR.

samples.src: Nakuba umgomo wokuvimbela i-HPV ukhona, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise ne-Namibia, abakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo.
samples.ref: Though a vaccine to prevent HPV exists, many women in African countries, including Namibia, don’t have access to it.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungenxa yezinto eziningi, okuhlanganise ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukuntuleka kolwazi, kanye nokuntuleka kokuxhumana.

samples.ref: This means that checking for the virus or the lesions it causes is especially important for these women, as it is the best way to help prevent cancer.

samples.ref: They investigated how effective some common types of tests (called screening methods) were for finding HPV and lesions.

samples.ref: They were also interested in comparing screening methods, for example collecting cells from the womb to check for damage compared to just looking for lesions.

samples.ref: They also wanted to know whether differences between women, like their age, or whether they had other diseases like HIV, changed their chances of getting HPV and cancer.

samples.src: Ukwazi lolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nemitholampilo ukuthi isebenzise izindlela zokuhlola ngempumelelo.

samples.ref: The researchers looked at patient records for 214 women who had been screened and treated for HPV, lesions, and cervical cancer at a hospital in Windhoek, Namibia.

samples.ref: By reviewing these records, they found that different screening techniques often gave medical staff different information, and that they might be more useful before or after HPV had developed into cancer.

samples.ref: Lesions, however, could often be found just with a visual inspection, using a technique called “visual inspection with acetic acid” (VIA).

samples.ref: This is because it uses basic medical equipment already used for women’s gynaecological examinations, like a speculum (a metal instrument used to look inside the vagina).

samples.ref: They also found that combining different methods often gave doctors more information about a woman’s risk for getting cancer, especially over multiple check-ups.

samples.ref: Prompted by international targets for elimination of hepatitis B virus (HBV), we set out to characterise individuals with HBV monoinfection vs. those coinfected with HBV/HIV, to evaluate the impact of therapy and to guide improvements in clinical care.

samples.ref: The researchers were able to show that individuals with HBV only were at a disadvantage when compared to those with both HIV and HBV, as patients infected with both viruses were likely to be on antiviral HIV treatment, which also offers some benefit in combating HBV infection.

samples.ref: The results from this study highlight the potential impact of differences between referral, monitoring and treatment options for HBV when compared to HIV and HBV coinfection, which favours those infected with both HIV and HBV.

samples.src: Ukuhlolwa Komthelela Wokungavikeleki Emisebenzini Yabesifazane Yezamabhizinisi E-SHIRORO Indawo Yohulumeni Wasekhaya yase-Niger State.
samples.ref: Assessment of the Impact of Insecurity on Women's Entrepreneurial Activities in SHIRORO Local Government Area of Niger State

samples.src: Lolu cwaningo luhlole umthelela wokungavikeleki emisebenzini yezamabhizinisi yabesifazane e-Shiroro Local Government Area of ​​Niger State, igxile kakhulu ezindabeni ezimayelana nokuncika kwabesifazane ngokwezimali, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yezamabhizinisi evamile phakathi kwabo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungavikeleki emabhizinisini abo.
samples.ref: This study examined the impact of insecurity on the entrepreneurial activities of women in Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State, focusing specifically on issues about women’s financial dependence, the kind of entrepreneurial activities common among them and the dimension of the impact of insecurity on their entrepreneurial endeavours.

samples.src: Kwahlolwa isampula yabesifazane abangama-377, okuholele ekutholakaleni kokuthi abesifazane baseShiroro bangosomabhizinisi abanezinga eliphezulu lokuzimela ngokwezimali, bazibandakanya kakhulu nama-SME.
samples.ref: A sample of 377 women was surveyed, leading to the findings that women in Shiroro are highly entrepreneurial with high level of financial independence, engaging mostly in SMEs.

samples.src: Ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi nakuba ukungavikeleki kunomphumela omubi emisebenzini yabesifazane yamabhizinisi ngendlela yokulahlekelwa noma ukwehla kwezimali phakathi kwezinye izinto, isibalo sabesifazane abangosomabhizinisi asizange sibe nokwehla okukhulu.
samples.ref: The study also found that while insecurity has an adverse effect on women’s entrepreneurial activities in the form of loss of or decline of capital among other things, the number of women entrepreneurs has not experienced a significant decline.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuthi ukungavikeleki kukhona noma cha akuyona into ebalulekile njengoba kucatshangwa.

samples.src: Ucwaningo luncome ukuthi izinhlelo ezisimeme zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zezezimali kufanele zidalwe futhi izinhlangano zamaphoyisa zomphakathi nazo kufanele zidalwe futhi ziqiniswe ukuze kuliwe nokungavikeleki endaweni yocwaningo.
samples.ref: The study recommended that sustainable programmes to improve women’s access to and use of financial services should be created and community policing organisations should also be created and strengthened to combat insecurity in the study area.

samples.src: Abesifazane bamabhizinisi eNiger badinga ukuvikeleka okwengeziwe

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi osomabhizinisi besifazane eNiger bangosomabhizinisi futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezigebengwini kuyinkinga.
samples.ref: Researchers found that businesswomen in Niger are highly entrepreneurial and financially independent, but safety from criminals is an issue.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi baphephe futhi bavikelekile kangakanani abesifazane abaqhuba amabhizinisi endaweni yaseShiroro Local Government Area of ​​Niger State, nokuthi lokhu kungase kube nomthelela onjani emabhizinisini abo kanye nokuzimela kwezezimali.
samples.ref: Researchers wanted to know how safe and secure women who run businesses in the Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State are, and how this may impact their businesses and financial independence.

samples.src: Baxoxisane nabesifazane abangu-377 bakule ndawo mayelana nezinselelo ababhekene nazo mayelana nebhizinisi labo, ukuncika kwezezimali kanye nokungavikeleki.
samples.ref: They interviewed 377 women in this area about the challenges they face in terms of their entrepreneurial activities, financial dependencies and insecurities.

samples.ref: They then adjusted their calculations to account for many other factors such as age, general health, and pregnancy history to tease out the suspected effects of the micronutrients in causing preterm birth.

samples.ref: With an exception of only two females that adapted well to the new crevices of translocation, all the other tortoises attempted homing, with 46.15% of them tracing their way back to their home crevices with accurate precision and 15.38% also reaching areas believed to be within their home range.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathole into emangazayo ngenkathi befunda ngokuziphatha kwezimfudu zamapancake aseMpumalanga Afrika (Malacochersus tornieri): izilwane zingathola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya ngemva kokuhanjiswa amabanga amade.
samples.ref: Researchers made a surprise discovery while studying the behaviour of East African pancake tortoises (Malacochersus tornieri): the animals can find their way back home after being moved over long distances.

samples.src: Ukuqonda ukuthi zikwenza kanjani lokhu futhi kungani zingabaluleka ekulondolozweni kwalezi zilwane ezihuquzelayo eziyivelakancane.

samples.ref: The home-finding behaviour these tortoises are displaying is called “homing”, and many other animals can do it as well.

samples.ref: Being able to return to specific places allows animals to get back to food, mates, and shelter, which improves their chances of surviving and breeding.

samples.ref: Although homing behaviour has been studied in sea and freshwater turtles, the researchers in this study say we still know very little about homing in tortoises (the land equivalents of turtles).

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda kabanzi mayelana nokuziphatha kwezimfudu ze-pancake endaweni yazo yemvelo ezindaweni ezinamadwala aseKenya.
samples.ref: In this study, the researchers wanted to understand more about the behaviour of pancake tortoises in their natural habitat in Kenya’s rocky outcrops.

samples.ref: They studied the animals as they moved and fed, and also when they went to rest in crevices, or gaps in the rock.

samples.ref: Another 15% of them managed to get back to the general area, but couldn’t find the crevice they’d originally been taken from.

samples.ref: The researchers say that this is the first time that homing behaviour has been seen in pancake tortoises, and that their results show that these animals prefer to live and rest in the same places whenever they can.

samples.src: Umthelela omuhle wokufakwa kwe-biochar nomquba ekuvundeni kwenhlabathi ubikwe ababhali abaningi.
samples.ref: The positive effect of biochar and compost applications on soil fertility has been reported by many authors.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, ukuthi lezi zinqubo zithinta kanjani ukwakheka komhlaba nokuguqulwa kwamazinga ahlukene, kanye nokuzimela kwazo ezimbonini ezihlukene, akazange ucwaningwe ngokwanele. Ucwaningo lwamanje luhlose ukuhlola umthelela we-biochar nomquba ekwakhiweni komhlaba, ukuguqulwa kwamazinga ahlukene, kanye nokuzimela kwezimo ezihlukene zokulimo.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, kuhlolisiswe ukufukamela kwaselebhorethri kwesinsuku ezingu-30 kusetshenziswa amasampula angu-120 g e-Haplic acrisol ihlanganiswe ne-biochar (cbio) yamahleza, ibiochar yamakhoba elayisi (rbio), ibiochar yamakhoba kakhokhonthi (coco300 and coco700) noma umquba wezinkukhu (compost); nomquba we-biocha yamakhoba elayisi(rcocomp) noma umquba webiochar yamahleza (cococomp) enanini lokuchitshiyelwa  lika 1% w/w: ngokulandelana kwenhlabathi.
samples.ref: In this study, a 30-day laboratory incubation experiment was done using 120 g samples each of a Haplic acrisol amended with corn cob biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut husk biochar (coco300 and coco700) or poultry manure compost (compost); and co- composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) or co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) at rates of 1 % w/w amendment: soil, respectively.

samples.src: Kolunye uhla lwalolu cwaningo kwahlanganiswa umquba wezinkukhu ne-biochar yamahleza noma yamakhoba elayisi (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola umthelela wawo ekuphefumuleni kwenhlabathi, i-pH yenhlabathi; ikhaboni e-microbial enhlabathi; umthamo wokushintshana kwama-cation; ikhaboni e-organic ephelele; i-nitrogen ephelele nobukhona be-nitrogen eningi.
samples.ref: Other treatments in the study were combined poultry manure compost and corn cob biochar or rice husk biochar (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), respectively, to examine their effects on basal soil respiration, soil pH; soil microbial carbon; cation exchange capacity; total organic carbon, total nitrogen and available nitrogen concentration.

samples.src: I-Biochar nomquba okufakwa ngakodwana noma ndawonye, nomquba we-biochar kunyuse i-pH yenhlabathi ngamayunithi e-pH angu 0.28-2.29 uma kuqhathaniswa nengeziwanga lutho.
samples.ref: Biochar and compost applied solely or together, and composted biochar increased soil pH by 0.28–2.29 pH units compared to the un-amended control.
samples.hyp: Ukwengeza kwe-biochar kunyusa ukukhishwa kwe-phosphorus, i-potassium, kanye ne-calcium, kodwa kunciphisa ukukhishwa kwe-zinc. Ukwengeza kwe-biochar kunyusa ukukhuthazwa kwezigidimincane, kodwa kunciphisa ukukhuthazwa kwe-fungi.

samples.src: Ukuphefumula okuvela emqubeni noma emqubeni wamakhoba elayisi, noma i-biochar yamahleza noma ehlanganisiwe nomquba kubephezulu kunalokhu okungathintwga, okufane nalokho okufakwe i-biochar yodwa.
samples.ref: Basal respiration from the sole compost or composted rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochar and compost were higher than the un-amended control, which was similar to that from the biochar only treatments.

samples.src: I-TOC esemqubeni wodwa nakwi-biochar yamahleza nalaokufakwekhona umquba inyuke ngo 37% no 117%, ngokulanelana, kunale ongenziwanga lutho.
samples.ref: TOC in the sole compost and combined corn cob biochar and compost treatments were up to 37% and 117% higher, respectively, than the control.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukwengezwa komquba kungathuthukisa kakhulu ukuguqulwa kwezinto ezilukhuni.

samples.src: Ukufakwa kwe-biochar yamakhoba elayisi exutshwe nomquba kukhuphule i-MBC ngo-132% ngesikhathi umquba wodwa ukhuphule i-MBC ngo-247%, ngokulandelana, uma kuqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engeziwanga lutho.
samples.ref: Combined application of rice husk biochar and compost increased MBC by 132% while sole compost addition increased MBC by 247%, respectively, compared to the control.

samples.src: Ekuvaleni, ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukufakwa ngakodwana noma kuxutshiwe komquba ne-biochar, noma umquba we-biochar kuthuthukisa amazinga ama-parameter enhlabathi njenge pH yenhlabathi neMBC, yakhuthaza nokuma kahle kwenhlabathi u-C ngokunyuswa kwe TOC  nokwehliswa kokulahlekelwa inhlabathi u-C ngokuphefumula kwayo.
samples.ref: In conclusion, the study demonstrated that sole or combined application of compost and biochar, or composted biochar improved soil quality parameters such as soil pH and MBC, and promoted soil C stabilization through enhanced TOC and reduced soil C loss through basal respiration.

samples.src: Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo esub-Saharan Afrika ukwehla kokuvunda komhlabathi.
samples.ref: One of the biggest problems facing crop production in sub-Saharan Africa is a decline in the fertility of soil.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kwehla kungenxa yezimo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukudongi okwengeziwe, ukusika komhlaba okungafanele, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezigaba zemfucuza. samples.ref: Better soil quality would lead to better crop yields, which would reduce rural poverty and reverse natural resource degradation

samples.src: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi i-biochar, ingasetshenziswa ukwenza ukuvunda kwenhlabathi kube ngcono.
samples.ref: Research has shown that biochar, a highly stable, carbon-rich material, can be used to improve soil fertility.
samples.hyp: I-biochar ingathuthukisa ukukhishwa kwamanzi, ukukhishwa komoya, kanye nokukhishwa kwezinto ezibalulekile ezifana ne-nitrogen ne-phosphorus. Lokhu kungenza izitshalo zikhule kangcono futhi zibe nokukhiqiza okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-biochar ingasiza ukunciphisa ukungcola komhlaba ngokunciphisa ukugaywa kwezinto eziyingozi.

samples.src: I-Biochar ivela uma kushiswa izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, endaweni engenawo umoya onempilo.
samples.ref: Biochar is the byproduct of heating organic matter, or biomass, in the presence of low or no oxygen.
samples.hyp: Ukusetshenziswa kwayo kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa impilo yomhlaba, ukulawulwa kwezigulo, kanye nokunciphisa ukuguquguquka kwe-carbon. Ukuhlaziywa kokuhlanganiswa kwe-biochar ne-compost kwabonisa ukuthi kungathuthukisa ukukhula kwezihlahla kanye nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi.

samples.src: I-Biochar isibonakele ukuthi iyayandisa indawo enenhlabathi, yandisa nokutholakala kwamanzi nomoya, bese ikhuthaza izakhi ezisenhlabathini.
samples.ref: Biochar has been shown to increase the surface area of soil, increase water and air availability, and activate microorganisms in the soil.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukusetshenziswa kwayo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokulungisa ukungcola komhlaba nokukhuthaza ukuguquguquka kwezinto eziluhlaza.

samples.src: Lolu cwaningo luhlole umthelela lwe-biochar nomquba ezingeni lenhlabathi lwasebenzisa izinkomba ezifana nokuphefumula kwenhlabathi, i-PH yenhlabathi, ubukhona bamagciwane, inani lekhabhoni, nenani le-nitrogen elikhona.
samples.ref: This study tested the effect of biochar and compost on soil quality using indicators such as soil respiration, soil pH, the presence of microbes, the amount of carbon, and the amount of nitrogen available.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bakhiqise ibiochar ngamahleza, ukhokhonathi namakhoba elayisi besebenzisa ipyrolysis, ebandakanya ukushiswa kwezinto eziphilayo endaweni engenawo umoya onempilo, eshiswa ngo-450 °C eziko elakhwe endaweni.
samples.ref: The researchers produced corn cob, coconut and rice husk biochars using pyrolysis, which involved heating organic matter in the absence of oxygen, at 450 °C in a locally produced kiln.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuhlale kukhona ukuguqulwa okuyisikhathi esikhulu.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bakhiqize ibiochar yamakhoba akhokhonathi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis eshiswe ngo 300 °C nango 700 °C.
samples.ref: The researchers produced coconut husk biochar using pyrolysis at 300 °C and at 700 °C.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-X-ray diffraction (XRD) kwakwabonisa ukuthi ibiochar eyenziwe ngo-300 °C inendawo ebanzi ye-crystallinity, kuyilapho ibiochar eyenziwe ngo-700 °C ibonisa ukwehla okukhulu ekubeni yindlela ehlanzekile.

samples.src: Abacwaningi babe sebefukamela amasampula enhlabathi ahlanganiswe ne-biochar amalanga angu-30.
samples.ref: The researchers then incubated soil samples mixed with the biochars for 30 days.
samples.hyp: Ngemuva kwalokho, bahlaziya ukuguquguquka kwama-enzyme ethile, okuyinto ekhiqizwa ngamabhaktheriya, ukubona ukuthi le biochar ingathinta kanjani ukusebenza kwabo. Ukuhlolwa kwama-enzyme kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, ukuze kubonwe ukuthi ukuguquguquka kwesimo sendawo kungathinta kanjani ukusebenza kwama-enzyme.

samples.src: Amasampula abequkethe inhlabathi elungiswe ngekhethelo ebizwa nge Haplic acrisol, ehlanganiswe nengxube yema-biochars akhiwe ngamahleza, amakhoba elayisi noma akhokhonathi, nomanyolo womquba wezinkukhu.
samples.ref: Each sample contained specially prepared soil called Haplic acrisol, which was mixed with different combinations of biochars made from corn cob, rice husk or coconut husk, and a poultry manure compost.

samples.src: Amanye amasampula abequkethe ingxube yenhlabathi nomquba wezinkukhu, ane-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, ne-biochar yamahleza.
samples.ref: Other samples contained a mix of soil and poultry manure compost , with rice husk biochar, and corn cob biochar, respectively.
samples.hyp: I-biochar yenzelwe ukuthuthukisa ukukhula kwezinto ezimpilako kanye nokunciphisa ukungcola emhlabathini. Ukuhlaziywa kwemininingwane kweminye yalezi zinhlanganisela kwabonisa ukuthi zithuthukisa ukukhula kwezihlahla kanye nokunciphisa ukungcola emhlabathini.

samples.src: Isampula ngalilodwa beliqukethe u-1% womquba, u1% we-biochar ngayinye, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuphenya umthelela wengxube ngayinye ezingeni lenhlabathi.
samples.ref: Each of the samples contained 1 % compost, 1% for each biochar, so that the researchers could investigate the effect of each mixture on soil quality.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwengeza i-biochar nomquba enhlabathini, ngakodwa noma ndawonye, kunyuse i-pH yenhlabathi yasuka ku 0.28-2.29 wamaynithi e-pH, uma eqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engaxutshiwe.
samples.ref: The researchers found that adding biochar and compost to the soil, either separately or together, increased the pH value of the soil from 0.28–2.29 pH units, compared to unmixed soil.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kukhuthaze ukukhula kweziguli ezifuywayo, ngakho-ke kwenza ukuthi ukulimo kuthuthuke. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-biochar nomquba kwakwenza ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-phosphorus, potassium, kanye ne-nitrogen kwenhlabathi kwandise, okwenza ukuthi ukulimo kuthuthuke.

samples.src: Ukunyuka kwe-pH kusho ukuthi inhlabathi iba ne-esidi encane.
samples.ref: An increase in pH means the soil became less acidic.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungabangela ukuthi izimpucuko zibe nezimpilo ezimbi, futhi kungathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezinto eziningi ezibalulekile ezimpucukweni. Ukwehliswa kwe-pH, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungabangela ukuthi izimpucuko zibe nezimpilo ezimbi, futhi kungathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezinto eziningi ezibalulekile ezimpucukweni.

samples.src: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukuphefumula, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa inhlabathi, linyuke uma kufakwa umquba kuphela, noma uma umquba uhlanganiswa ne-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, yamahleza noma ama-biochar axutshiwe.
samples.ref: The study found that basal respiration, or the minimum amount of carbon dioxide being released by the soil, increased when either compost alone was added, or when compost was mixed with rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochars.

samples.src: Amasampula enhlabathi akhombise ikunyuka kwe-organic carbon content ngo 37% uma kusetshenziswa umquba kuphela, nokunyuka ngo 117% uma kuxutshwe i-biochar yamahleza nomquba.
samples.ref: The soil samples showed an increase in total organic carbon content of 37% when compost alone was used, and an increase of 117% when corn cob biochar was mixed with compost.

samples.src: Inani lokusebenza kwama-microorganism kunyuke ngo 132% lapho inhlabathi uxutshwe nomquba ne-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, uma iqhathaniswa nokunyuka ngo 247% emasampuleni enhlabani abenomquba kuphela.
samples.ref: The amount of microorganism activity increased by 132% where the soil had a mixture of compost and rice husk biochar, compared to an increase of 247% in soil samples that had compost alone.

samples.src: Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ibonisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukwehlisa i-esidi yenhlabathi nge-biochar, etholakala kalula futhi eshibhile.
samples.ref: The results of this research show that it is possible to decrease soil acidity using biochar, which is easily and cheaply available.

samples.src: Lokhu kuqhathaniswa nokufaka umcako enhlabathini, okubuzayo futhi okungatholakali kalula kubalimi abasafufusa e- sub-Saharan Afrika.
samples.ref: This is in contrast to the alternative practice of liming the soil, which is costly and scarcely available to smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa.
samples.hyp: Ukwengeza ukuthi ukufakwa kwalesi simo kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezindleleni ezihlukene, okuhlanganisa ukukhuthazwa kwempilo yezempucuko, ukuguqulwa kwezindlela zokulima, kanye nokwanda kokuxhaswa kwezomnotho.

samples.ref: We therefore compared indices of vascular function, inflammation, coagulation and fibrin clot composition in RA patients with healthy controls and evaluated inter-parameter relationships.

samples.hyp: Kusetshenzisiwe ukuhlaziywa kwe-RNA kwe-mRNA ye-circulating microRNA (miRNA) ukuze kutholwe amapharamitha e-miRNA angahlanganiswa nobuchwepheshe be-RA.

samples.src: Amazinga e-SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 ne-VCAM-1 akalwe nge-sandwich immunoassay.

samples.hyp: I-Thromboelastography ithatha imizuzu eyi-15 ukuze iphothulwe, futhi ihlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwegesi elingaxhunywe. Ukuhlaziywa kwegesi elingaxhunywe kuthathwa njengokubonisa ukuthi ukuguqulwa okungafani okukhona ku-genome kungathinta kanjani ukuguqulwa kwegesi.

samples.ref: Fibrin clot networks and fiber structure was investigated using Scanning Electron Microscopy.

samples.ref: The detection and quantification of citrullination in formed fibrin clots were performed using a fluorescently labeled Citrulline monoclonal antibody with Confocal Microscopy.

samples.src: Ukugcwala kakhulu kwe-SAA, i-CRP ne-ICAP-1 bekubonakala kunyuka ezigulini ze-RA uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye.
samples.ref: Concentrations of SAA, CRP and ICAM-1 were significantly elevated in RA patients compared to controls.
samples.hyp: Amanani e-SAA, i-CRP ne-ICAP-1 ayisibonakaliso esisodwa esisetshenziswa ukukhomba ukutheleleka kwe-RA.

samples.src: Ama-TEG parameters ahlobene nokuqala kokujiya anbizwa ngo (R no K), akala  la kuhlangana khona ama-fibrin (α-Angle), afike kwi-thrombus ephelele (TMRTG) ehlile ezigulini ze-RA.
samples.ref: TEG parameters relating to coagulation initiation (R and K), rate of fibrin cross-linking (α-Angle), and time to reach maximum thrombus generation (TMRTG) were attenuated in RA patients.

samples.src: Ama-parameter abeka amandla ehlule (MA, MRTG, TGG) awahlukanga ngokwezibalo uma ubheka ama-RA nokuhlolwa ngabo.
samples.ref: Parameters relating to clot strength (MA, MRTG, TGG) did not statistically differ between RA and controls.

samples.src: Ukuhlehla kwezindlela zokusebenza kuveze ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwama- reactants (CRP,SAA) nama-TEG parameters nezinkomba ezisebenza nge-endothelial.
samples.ref: Logistic regression modelling revealed stronger association between acute phase reactants (CRP, SAA) with TEG parameters than endothelial function markers.

samples.src: Ukupopola ngama-microscope kuveze ama-fibrinn fiber ahlangene kakhulu ezigulini ze-RA uma uqhathanisa nokuhlolwa ngabo[[median (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm respectively, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
samples.ref: Microscopic analysis revealed denser networks of thicker fibrin fibers in RA patients compared to controls [median (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm respectively, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).

samples.ref: Detection of multiple citrullinated regions within fibrin clot structures in RA patients, which was less prevalent in control samples (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
samples.hyp: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukucutshungulwa kwe-citrulline kungaba yindlela yokubona okwengeziwe ekuhlolweni kwezifo ze-RA.

samples.src: Eziguli ze-RA ziveza ukujiya okungafani neziphumo ezijwayelekile ezibandakanywa nezifo zokuvuvukala.
samples.ref: Patients with active RA display a coagulation profile that is dissimilar to general findings associated with other inflammatory conditions.

samples.src: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zamaphrotheni kungadlala indima ekutholeni ukwakheka kwe-fibrin namathuba okudlulisa izimo eziphakeme ze-thrombotic ezigulini ze-RA.
samples.ref: The alteration of protein structures by autoimmune linked citrullination could play a role in determining the structure of fibrin and the potential of conferring a heightened thrombotic risk in RA patients.

samples.src: Kungenzeka ukuthi amathuba okuphathwa isifo senhliziyo nohlangothi andiswa ukwakheka kwamahlule egazi ezigulini zesifo samathambo.
samples.ref: Blood clotting in arthritis patients may explain their increased risk for heart attack, stroke

samples.src: Ucwaningo olusha lwesifo samathambo seluveze ukuqonda kangcono ukuhlangana okungase kube khona phakathi kwalesi sifo kanye nokwanda kwengozi yezifo ezibandakanya inhliziyo.
samples.ref: New research into rheumatoid arthritis has provided a better understanding of potential links between this condition and increased cardiovascular disease risk.

samples.src: Isifo samathambo (RA), isifo esibuhlungu esiqedana amandla silwe nezakhi zomzimba, sibanda, esihambisana nokuvuvukala kwamalunga amajoyinti omzimba wonke.
samples.ref: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a painful and debilitating autoimmune condition, associated with inflammation in the joints and throughout the body.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-genomic kwezibini ze-RA zibonise ukuthi kukhona ukuguqulwa okuhlukile okuningi okubangelwa ukuguqulwa kwe-genetic.

samples.src: Sekube isikhathi esijana, ososayensi bazi ukuthi abahlushwa ilesi sifo basemathubeni angu-50% okuphathwa izifo ezihambiselana ne-cardiovascular disease (CVD) - njengokushawa uhlangothi noma inhliziyo.
samples.ref: For some time now, scientists have known that sufferers of the disease also have a 50% higher risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes – like strokes or heart attacks.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, ukuthi kungani ukuthi abantu abahlushwa yileli sifo banenkinga enkulu yalesi sifo, akazange kucwaningwe kakhulu.

samples.src: Into edala lokhu kakhulu umthelela wokuvuvukala ekwakhekeni kwamahlule egazi.
samples.ref: A key factor in that risk is the effect inflammation has on the blood clotting process.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenye lobu budlelwane, ukuthola ukuthi kungani i-RA inyusa amathuba okuba ne-CVD.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers investigated this relationship, to find out exactly why RA heightens CVD risk.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwenziwa kubafundi abangu-300 abatholakala eNyuvesi yaseKapa. Abafundi babekhishwa ngendlela ehambisanayo, ngokusho kwenani labafundi ngohlanga, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kukhawulelwe ngokulinganayo phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Abafundi bagunyazwe ukuthi bayobe behlale bephila ngendlela enempilo, ngaphandle kokudla okugcwele amasukwane, futhi bagunyazwe ukuthi bayobe behlale bephapheme amanzi angama-litela amabili ngosuku.

samples.src: Into abacwaningi abayibhekisise kakhulu, kube umthelela wokuvuvukala nokuguquka kwamanye amaphrotheni abizwa ngama-fibrins  abandakanyeka ekwakhekeni kwamahlule egazi.
samples.ref: More specifically, the researchers examined the effects of inflammation and structural changes on specific proteins associated with blood-clotting, called fibrins.
samples.hyp: Ngokungafani namanye ama-genome, leli gama liyisibalo esikhulu kakhulu, eliyisikhathi esikhulu kakhulu.

samples.src: Lamaphrotheni avela engamaketango amade ahlanganisa amahlule egazi, ngakho ke izinguquko ezenzeka kuma-fibrins angadala ukwakheka kwamahlule.
samples.ref: These proteins occur as long chains that form the basic “mesh-work” for blood clots, so any changes to the fibrins themselves could have knock-on effects for the clotting process overall.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baqhathanise amasampula egazi ezigule eziphethwe i-RA nawabantu abangaguli.
samples.ref: Researchers compared blood samples of RA patients to samples from healthy individuals.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwegesi kwenziwa ukuze kutholwe izinga le-methane (CH4) kanye ne-carbon dioxide (CO2) emithonjeni yegesi eyenziwe ngamasampula. Ukuhlolwa kwegesi kwenziwa kabili, kanye nangesikhathi elinganiselwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanani atholwe afanele.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bebebheka “izinkomba” ezikhomba ukuvuvukala egazini, baphinde babheke ezinye izimkomba ezingajwayelekile ekwakhekeni kwamahlule okungadala ukuphathwa i-CVD kunyuke.
samples.ref: In each case, the researchers were looking for “markers” in the blood that indicate inflammation, as well as for any unusual differences in the normal clotting process that could heighten CVD risk.

samples.src: Kuhlaziywe namahlule uqobo lwawo nge-microscope, ukuzekubonakale izinguquko ekwakhekeni kwamaphrotheni ama-fibrin.
samples.ref: The clots themselves were also analysed microscopically, to identify any changes to the structure of their fibrin proteins.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kwaholela ekubonisweni kokuthi ukuguqulwa okungafani okukhulu okutholwe kwakuyizinto ezilandelayo: i-alanine ku-threonine (A->T) endaweni ye-127, i-valine ku-isoleucine (V->I) endaweni ye-131, kanye ne-phenylalanine ku-tyrosine (F->Y) endaweni ye-133.

samples.src: Abacwaningi babone ukuthi amahlule atholakala ezigulini eziphethwe i-RA akheka ngokushesha uma ziqhathaniswa nabantu abangaguli, bathola nokuthi amaphrotheni akha lawo mahlule akhuluphele kunama-fibrins ajwayelekile.
samples.ref: The researchers noticed that clots from RA patients formed faster than those in healthy individuals, and that the protein strands they were made of were also significantly thicker than normal fibrins.

samples.src: Kube khona nezinguquko kuma-amino acids akha amaphrotheni amafibrin, okudale ukuthi kusukume amasosha omzimba okudale ukuthi kuqhubeke ukuvuvukala.
samples.ref: There were also changes to the amino acids that make up the fibrin proteins, which caused them to trigger the body’s immune response, leading to further inflammation.

samples.src: Abanye abacwaningi babone izinguquko ekwakhekeni kwama-amino acid amafibrins emalungeni amajoyinti eziguli eziphethwe i-RA ngaphambilini, kodwa kuyaqala ukuthi bathole izinto ezifanayo egazini.
samples.ref: Other researchers have noticed changes to the amino acid structure of fibrins in the joints of RA patients before, but this is the first time researchers have seen the same effect in blood.

samples.src: Uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinguquko ezibonakale emahluleni egazi, okutholakele kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi baqonde ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD, nokutholakala kwezimpawu zalezi zifo kusanesikhathi.
samples.ref: Combined with the other changes seen in the blood clots, the findings may help scientists develop a deeper understanding of the relationship between RA and CVD, and how to detect early signs of these diseases.

samples.src: Yize okutholakele kuthembisa, akusho lutho ukuthi abantu abacwaningiwe bambalwa.
samples.ref: Though these initial results are promising, it’s worth noting that the sample size for the study was comparatively small.
samples.hyp: Okwengeziwe, ukuthi abacwaningi basebenzise izindlela ezifushane zokuhlaziya idatha, kungathinta ukuthi yini okutholakele.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathe indlela indlela abayisebenzisile ukuthola izingiquko zama-amino acid kumaphrotheni, kungenzeka ukuthi zithole imiphumela evela ezindaweni ezingahlangani, okusho ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe amathesti aqonde ama-fibrin esikhathini esizayo.
samples.ref: The researchers also mentioned that the method they used to detect amino acid changes in the proteins could also have picked up results from unrelated substances, meaning that more specific tests targeting fibrins would be needed to confirm the result in future.

samples.src: Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, ukuqonda ukuqonda ukuhlangana okujulile phakathi kwe-RA nokutheleleka nge-CVD, lokhu kungasiza abaphethwe i-RA ngokubatholela isindlela zokwelapha lezi zifo kahle.
samples.ref: In the long run, understanding the complex links between RA and increased CVD risk may improve outcomes for RA patients as we learn to identify and treat these diseases more effectively.

samples.src: The Lushoto case
samples.ref: The Lushoto Case
samples.hyp: study, conducted in the Lushoto district of Tanzania, investigated the prevalence of malaria and its associated risk factors among pregnant women. The study involved a cross-sectional design, where data was collected from a sample of 400 pregnant women through questionnaires and clinical examinations. The results showed that the prevalence of malaria was 25%, with a higher prevalence observed in women who had not received any malaria prevention measures. The study also identified several risk factors associated with malaria infection, including age, parity, and place of residence. These findings highlight the importance of implementing effective malaria prevention strategies, particularly for pregnant women in high-risk areas.

samples.src: Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu kubalimi base-Tanzania, njengoba izwe selivele linesivuno esiphansi sezitshalo ezibalulekile zokusanhlamvu ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.
samples.ref: This is a particularly relevant issue for Tanzanian farmers, as the country is already experiencing lower yields of important cereal crops because of climate change.

samples.src: Kodwa, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukukala impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, okufana nokwenza umquba, futhi abalimi ngokwabo akuboniswana ngaso sonke isikhathi mayelana nokuthi ukungenelela kusebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe.
samples.ref: But, researchers say it is difficult to measure the success of climate-smart interventions, such as composting, and farmers themselves are not always consulted about whether interventions are working as intended.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuklama indlela yokulinganisa impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekuthuthukiseni ukuphepha kokudla kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
samples.ref: In this study, the researchers wanted to design a method to measure the success of climate smart interventions, with a specific focus on improving food security and adaptability.

samples.src: Ukuqala, bafunde ezinye izincwaningo zezolimo futhi bakhiqiza uhlu olu-2 oluhlanganisa izici ezili-14, noma “izinkomba”, ezibalulekile ekulinganiseni ukuvikeleka kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
samples.ref: To start, they read through other agricultural studies and produced 2 lists that included 14 factors, or “indicators”, that are important for measuring food security and adaptation.

samples.src: Kwathi, besebenza eSifundeni sase-Lushoto e-Tanzania, abacwaningi babambisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe abambalwa bezolimo ukuze bahlonze iznkomba ezibaluleke kakhulu ohlwini ngalunye.
samples.ref: Then, working in the Lushoto District of Tanzania, the researchers collaborated with local farmers and several agriculture experts to identify the most important indicators from each list.

samples.src: Abalimi bahlonze ukukhiqizwa kokudla njengenkomba ebaluleke kakhulu yokuqinisekisa ukutholakala kokudla.
samples.ref: The farmers identified food production as a very important indicator for ensuring food security.

samples.src: Ngamanye amazwi, noma yikuphi ukungenelela okuthuthukisa isivuno ezitshalweni zabo kwakwaziswa kakhulu.
samples.ref: In other words, any interventions that improved the yield from their crops were highly valued.

samples.src: Khonamanjalo, mayelana nesimo sokuguquguquka, abalimi babethakasela kakhulu ukungenelela okubasize bavikele inhlabathi yamapulazi abo, kanye nalezo ezithuthukisa ulwazi lwabo, amakhono kanye nemali engenayo.
samples.ref: Meanwhile, for the adaptability aspect, the farmers were particularly interested in interventions that helped them protect their farms’ soil, and those that improved their own knowledge, skills, and income.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezifanele, kanye nokufundiswa okuyisikhathi, kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokunciphisa ukungatholakali kwezigaba ezithile zolwazi.

samples.src: Uma abacwaningi sebekutholile ukubaluleka kwenkomba ngayinye, bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ukuhlola ukuthi ngabe izinhlobo eziyisithupha zokungenelela e-Lushoto ziphumelele yini.
samples.ref: Once the researchers had determined the importance of each indicator, they were able to use them to test whether six types of interventions in Lushoto were successful.

samples.src: Esimweni ngasinye, babuze abalimi bendawo, esikalini soku-1-5, ukuthi ngabe kube khona yini ukwanda kwenkomba ngayinye kusukela kwaqala ukungenelela.
samples.ref: In each case, they asked local farmers, on a scale of 1-5, whether there had been an increase in each indicator since the intervention started.

samples.src: Lokhu kubavumele ukuthi babone ukuthi yikuphi ukungenelela okube nomthelela omkhulu ekuvikelekeni kokudla kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
samples.ref: This allowed them to see which of the interventions had the strongest effect on food security and adaptation.

samples.src: Bathole ukungenelela oku-3 kuphela kokuyi-6 okusetshenziswayo kube nomthelela wangampela.
samples.ref: They found only 3 of the 6 interventions being used had a real impact.

samples.src: Labo babefaka umquba, lezo kwakuyizinhlobo zezitshalo ezikwazi ukumelana nesomiso, futhi zinikeza ifolishi elingcono lezilwane zokudla.
samples.ref: Those were composting, drought-tolerant crop varieties, and providing better forage for food animals.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungenelela kwekusasa kufeza izidingo zabalimi base-Lushoto kanjalo nezinjongo zolimo ezihlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.
samples.ref: The researchers say their method makes it easier to ensure that future interventions meet the needs of Lushoto’s farmers as well as the objectives of climate smart agriculture.

samples.src: BAnezela ukuthi ukukhetha ukungenelela okufanele kwandisa amathuba okuthi abalimi bancome imikhuba emihle komakhelwane babo, ngaleyo ndlela basabalalise imibono ehlakaniphile yezolimo yesimo sezulu.
samples.ref: They add that choosing the right interventions also increases the chance that farmers will recommend good practices to their neighbours, thereby spreading climate smart ideas.

samples.src: Ngokwemibandela ebanzi, idnlela ingasetshenziswa nakwezinye izifunda, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu anobuhlakani besimo sezulu athatha izimo zendawo kanye nolwazi lomlimi ngokuqapha nokuhlola okuqhubekayo.
samples.ref: In broader terms, the method can also be used in other regions, and can help ensure climate smart strategies take local conditions and farmer knowledge into account through continuous monitoring and evaluation.

samples.src: Ngokwenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zezolimo ezihlakaniphile ngokwesimo sezulu zingase zibe yimpumelelo futhi zithole amandla, e-Tanzania nakwamanye amazwe e-Afrika.
samples.ref: By doing so, climate-smart agriculture initiatives are more likely to be successful and gain traction, both in Tanzania and further abroad in Africa.

samples.src: Ucwaningo lwezilwane ezigulayo njengezilwane zangaphandle ezihlaselayo alukanakwa kakhulu emkhakheni wesayensi yokuhlasela.
samples.ref: The study of disease organisms as invasive alien species has not received a great deal of attention in the field of invasion science.

samples.src: Amagciwane angenisiwe angaba nethonya elinamandla ezintweni eziphilayo, izimiso zemvelo ezihlala kuzo, kanye nezomnotho ezisekelwa imvelo.
samples.ref: Introduced pathogens can have profound effects on living organisms, the ecosystems that they inhabit, and the economies that the ecosystems support.

samples.src: Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezifo ezethulwe zezilwane ezifuywayo nezasendle (i-canine rabies, isifo sofuba sezinkomo, kanye ne-rinderpest) kanye nabantu (i-smallpox, isimungumungwane kanye negciwane lesandulela ngculazi, i-HIV) ukuze sibonise izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zifo ezingaba nazo.
samples.ref: In this chapter, we use case studies of introduced diseases of domestic and wild animals (canine rabies, bovine tuberculosis, and rinderpest) and humans (smallpox, measles and human immunodeficiency virus, HIV) to illustrate the kinds of effects that these pathogens can have.
samples.hyp: Siphinde sibheka ukuthi ukutholakala kwezifo eziningi ezifuywayo nezilwane zasendle kungathinta kanjani impilo yomphakathi.

samples.src: Umthelela omkhulu kunayo yonke kuze kube manje kwaba yi-rinderpest, eyabulala izigidi zezinkomo, futhi yaqothula izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu ze-Afrika eseningizimu.
samples.ref: The most dramatic impact to date was that of rinderpest, which caused the death of millions of cattle, and practically annihilated certain forms of wildlife from large parts of southern Africa.

samples.src: Lokhu kube nomthelela omubi emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ekwakhekeni nasekuguquguqukeni kwezinhlelo zemvelo.
samples.ref: This in turn impacted severely on the region’s economy, and resulted in large-scale changes to the structure and dynamics of ecosystems.
samples.hyp: Ukukhuthazwa kwezimo ezilukhuni kuye kwenza ukuthi abantu bangaboni ukuthi ukulondolozwa kwemvelo kubalulekile, okuyinto ebangela ukuthi kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa kwemikhakha ekhuthazwe ukulondolozwa kwemvelo.

samples.src: I-Rinderpest isiqediwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa kokubili amarabi e-canine nesifo sofuba sezinkomo kusekhona, futhi ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuphathwa kuyodingeka ukuze kuqukethwe.
samples.ref: Rinderpest has been eradicated globally, but both canine rabies and bovine tuberculosis remain, and ongoing vigilance and management will be required to contain them.

samples.src: Ezifweni zabantu, ingxibongo isiqediwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa umphumela walesi sifo, owethulwa amakoloni aseYurophu, wawubuhlungu kakhulu.
samples.ref: Of the human diseases, smallpox has also been eradicated globally, but the effect of the disease, introduced by European colonists, was devastating.

samples.src: Ekuqaleni kwawo-1700, ingxenye enkulu (kufika ku-90% kweminye imiphakathi) yabantu bomdabu baseKhoekhoe bafa, becekela phansi isiko labo kanye nendlela yabo yokuphila, futhi kwashiya abambalwa abasindile ukuba babuthwe njengabasebenzi basemapulazini.
samples.ref: In the early 1700s, a large proportion (up to 90% in some communities) of the indigenous Khoekhoe people died, destroying their culture and way of life, and leaving the few survivors to be recruited as farm labourers.

samples.src: I-HIV, eyatholwa okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982 nayo ibe nomthelela omkhulu futhi ukwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane kukodwa okwamanje kubiza uhulumeni i-ZAR 66.4 billion njalo ngonyaka.
samples.ref: HIV, first detected in South Africa in 1982 has also had substantial impacts and antiretroviral treatment alone currently costs the government ZAR 66.4 billion annually.

samples.src: Siphinde sihlanganise i-West Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo ezaqala e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni wonke.
samples.ref: We also include West Nile Virus and African Swine Fever as examples of diseases that originated in Africa, and that may yet become globally destructive.

samples.src: Sibikezela ukuthi izifo ezintsha zizovela njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwandisa ububanzi bazo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba amanani ohwebo akhula.
samples.ref: We predict that new diseases will emerge as humans continue to expand their range into wild areas, and as trade volumes increase.

samples.src: Lokho ososayensi abakwaziyo ngabahlaseli abancane kakhulu ababanga izifo eNingizimu Afrika
samples.ref: What scientists know about microscopic invaders that cause disease in South Africa
samples.hyp: , kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nezifo zabo.

samples.src: Lesi sahluko sifingqa imininingwane yakamuva ngezifo ezifana ne-rinderpest, amarabi, isimungumungwane kanye ne-HIV, zonke ezibangelwa amagciwane ahlaselayo (amagciwane, amagciwane nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezithathwa njengezilwane okungezona ezomdabu, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo emzimbeni indawo ethile).
samples.ref: This book chapter summarises the latest information on diseases such as rinderpest, rabies, measles and HIV, all caused by invasive microorganisms (viruses, bacteria and other small creatures that are considered a non-native species, meaning that they are not naturally found in a particular environment).

samples.src: Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqubuka kwezifo kugcina kulimaza umnotho wezwe.
samples.ref: These diseases all affect animals and people in South Africa, and outbreaks ultimately hurt the country’s economy.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwezifiso zokwelashwa kwezifo ezithinta izilwane kudinga ukuhlaziywa okunzulu kwezifiso zokwelashwa ezikhona, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezindlela ezintsha zokwelashwa.

samples.src: Emkhakheni wocwaningo obizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi ehlaselayo’, ososayensi bacwaninga ngezinto eziphilayo ezichumayo nezidala umonakalo ngemva kokwethulwa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokuvamile.
samples.ref: In a field of research called ‘invasive science’, scientists study organisms that thrive and cause harm after being introduced into new environments where they are not normally found.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwezinto ezilukhuni, izifo, kanye nezilonda.

samples.src: Ucwaningo oluningi lugxile “ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezihlaselayo” ezinkulu njengezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa abahlaseli abancane abangebona izifo babaluleke kakhulu.
samples.ref: Most research has focussed on large “invasive species” like plants and animals, but microscopic invaders that cause disease are as important.

samples.src: Kulesi sahluko, ababhali badingide ngezifo zezilwane nezabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezibangelwa yilabo abangenwa ama-microorganisms.
samples.ref: In this chapter, the authors discussed some animal and human diseases in South Africa that are caused by those introduced microorganisms.
samples.hyp: Ababhali baphinde baphinde bacebise ukuthi ukuhlaziywa okujulile kwebhayoloji yezifo ezibangelwa yilawa ma-microorganisms kungaba yisikhuthazo sokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha ezintsha.

samples.src: Bathe esiyingozi kakhulu isifo ‘i-rinderpest’, esatholwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
samples.ref: They said the most dangerous was the ‘rinderpest’ disease, detected in South Africa in 1896.
samples.hyp: Lesi sifo saba yingozi enkulu kubantu, ngoba sabangela ukufa kwamahlathi amakhulu, futhi sabangela ukuthi abantu abaningi basuswe ezindlini zabo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lesi sifo sabangela ukuthi ukudla kunciphe, okubangela ukungabikwa kwezifo eziningi.

samples.src: I-Rinderpest yabangelwa igciwane futhi yathinta izinkomo nezinyathi.
samples.ref: Rinderpest was caused by a virus and affected cattle and buffaloes.
samples.hyp: Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuhlaziywa kwe-genome kwakwazi ukuthola ukuthi ukuguqulwa okuyisisekelo okuyodwa kwakuyimbangela yalesi sifo.

samples.src: Igciwane elifanayo libangele isimungumungwane kubantu.
samples.ref: The same virus caused measles in people.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa okuningi kwenziwa ukuze kutholwe ukuthi kungani leli gciwane libangele ukugaya kwebhayoloji.

samples.src: Abantu abaningi basemaphandleni babhekane nendlala ngemva kokugqashuka kuka-1896, kodwa lesi sifo manje sesiqediwe ngokugoma.
samples.ref: Many rural people faced hunger after the 1896 outbreak, but the disease has now been eradicated through vaccination.

samples.src: Ababhali bathe phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861 izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zinamarabi nakuba abantu bengazi ukuthi yisiphi isifo lesi.
samples.ref: The authors said between 1772 and 1861, many dogs in South Africa had rabies, even though people did not know what disease this was.

samples.src: Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi amarabi ayebangelwa igciwane, ngakho uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezithintekile futhi agome lezo ezingathintekile.

samples.src: Ososayensi baqhathanisa i-Covid-19 namagciwane ahlobene ukuze basize ekutholeni imithi yokugoma
samples.ref: Scientists compare Covid-19 to related viruses to help find vaccines

samples.src: NgoSepthemba 2020, ososayensi baseMali baqhathanisa imininingwane yofuzo evela egciwaneni le-Covid-19 nokhuvethe olu-2 oluhlobene eduze ukuze bahlonze izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukisweni komgomo.
samples.ref: In September 2020, scientists in Mali compared genetic information from the Covid-19 virus to 2 closely related coronaviruses to identify features that could help in vaccine development.

samples.src: Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babesathungatha imigomo ephumelelayo ye-Covid-19.
samples.ref: At the time, scientists were still searching for successful Covid-19 vaccines.

samples.src: Bebefuna ukuhlonza uguquko lwegciwane le-Covid-19 olungabamba iqhaza ekuthelelekeni.
samples.ref: They wanted to identify mutations in the Covid-19 virus that could play a role in infection.

samples.src: Ngakho-ke abacwaningi baseMaliya baqhathanisa igciwane le-Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) namanye ama-coronavirus amabili abangela izifo kubantu, okuyi-MERS-CoV kanye ne-SARS-CoV.
samples.ref: The Malian researchers therefore compared the Covid-19 virus (SARS-CoV-2) to two other coronaviruses that cause disease in humans, namely MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV.

samples.src: Enye yezinhloso ezinkulu zalolu cwaningo bekuwukukhomba izindawo ezithile zegciwane le-Covid-19, ezibizwa ngama-epitopes, ezingabonwa amasosha omzimba womuntu.
samples.ref: One of the main aims of the study was to identify specific areas on the Covid-19 virus, called epitopes, that can be recognized by the human immune system.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela zokwelapha kanye nezindlela zokugwema leli gciwane. Ukuhlolwa kwama-epitopes kwenziwa ngokuhlaziya ukuguqulwa kwe-RNA ye-SARS-CoV-2 evela ezamphelini eziningi.

samples.src: Ukuyikhomba kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi bakhe imigomo esebenza kangcono.
samples.ref: Identifying them can help scientists to create more effective vaccines.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphinde baqhathanisa womathathu amagciwane ukuze babone ukuthi kukhona yini ukufana kofuzo okungasiza ekuthuthukisweni komgomo.
samples.ref: The researchers also compared all three viruses to see whether there were genetic similarities that could further help in vaccine development.

samples.src: Bagxile ekulandelaneni kofuzo lwamaprotheni e-spike amagciwane, okungamaprotheni anesibopho sokusiza ama-coronavirus abophe, futhi atheleleke, izakhi zomuntu.
samples.ref: They focussed on the genetic sequence of the viruses’ spike proteins, which are the proteins responsible for helping coronaviruses bind to, and infect, human cells.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa kwama-sequence okufuzo kwama-RNA okufuzo kwama-SARS-CoV-2 kwenziwa ezinhlotsheni eziningi, ukuze kutholwe ukuthi ukuguqulwa okufuzo okuyini okuyonawo okubalulekile ekuguqulweni kwesibopho se-ACE2.

samples.src: Okutholwe abacwaningi ukuthi amaprotheni e-spike awo womathathu amagciwane ayefana kakhulu ngokofuzo, ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezisebenzisana nezakhi zomuntu.
samples.ref: What the researchers found was that the spike proteins of all three viruses were very genetically similar, especially the parts that interact with human cells.

samples.src: Okwagqama ngegciwane le-Covid-19 ukuthi kube noshintsho oluncane kuphrotheni ye-spike engenza leli gciwane lisebenze kahle ekubopheni izakhi zabantu.
samples.ref: What stood out about the Covid-19 virus was that there were some slight changes in the spike protein that could make the virus more efficient at binding to human cells.

samples.src: Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ingase ivumele abanye abacwaningi ukuthi bakhe imigomo i-Covid-19 esebenza kangcono ngokubasiza ukuthi bakhombe izindawo ezikuleli gciwane okuhloswe ngazo ukuthola imigomo.
samples.ref: The findings from this study may allow other researchers to develop more effective Covid-19 vaccines by helping them to identify areas on the virus that are good targets for vaccines.

samples.src: Lolu cwaningo luphinde lwakhiphs ulwazi olusha mayelana nokufana kofuzo kanye nomehluko phakathi kwegciwane le-Covid-19 nolunye ukhuvethe.
samples.ref: The study also provided new information about the genetic similarities and differences between the Covid-19 virus and other coronaviruses.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwama-genome kwama-sample ahlukene aqokelelwe ezweni lase-Afrika kuholele ekutholweni kwamaphenethi amaningi afana kanye ahlukene. Lokhu kulwazi kululekile ekugwethelweni kwezindlela zokuhlaziya nokuhlenga izindlela zokwelapha ezifanele.

samples.src: Abaphenyi baqaphele ukuthi ucwaningo oluzayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni umehluko wofuzo egciwaneni le-Covid-19 ulenza litheleleke kakhulu futhi libe yingozi kakhulu kunamanye ama-coronavirus.
samples.ref: The researchers noted that future research should focus on whether genetic differences in the Covid-19 virus make it more infective and more dangerous than other coronaviruses.

samples.src: Ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile ezigulini ezinkhuvethe i-COVID-19: Ukubuyekezwa Okuhlelekile kanye nokuhlaziywa kwe-Meta
samples.ref: Cardiac Arrhythmias in Patients with COVID-19: A Systematic review and Meta-analysis

samples.src: Imuva lokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile akukwazi ukushawa indiva ezigulini ezinesifo sokhuvethe kowezi-2019 (COVID-19) njengoba inomthelela omkhulu kwimphumela.
samples.ref: Cardiac arrhythmia cannot be overlooked in patients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) as it carries a great influence on the outcomes.

samples.src: Ngakho, lolucwaningo lufuna ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile ngezigameko zokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile ezigulini ezinokhuvethe i-COVID-19.
samples.ref: Hence, this study aimed to build concrete evidence regarding the incidence of cardiac arrhythmia in patients with COVID-19.

samples.src: Izindlela esizenze ukubheka okuhlelekile kolwazi oluthembekile/ izinjini zokusesha okufaka kuzo i-PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane library kanye ne-Web of science.

samples.ref: Nine studies were finally included in our study consisting of 1445 patients.
