samples.src: Isifo senhliziyo sivame kakhulu engxenyeni eseningizimu ye-Botswana, futhi abalimi kuleyo ndawo balahlekelwa imfuyo yabo ngenxa yalesi sifo.
samples.ref: Heartwater is very common in the southern part of Botswana, and farmers in that area are losing their livestock to the disease.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenye umthwalo wesifo senhliziyo eningizimu ye-Botswana.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers investigated the burden of heartwater in southern Botswana.
samples.hyp: Bahlanganise idatha yezokwelapha yeziguli ezingu-1000 ezitholwe ezikhungweni zokwelapha ezihlukene. Ukuhlaziywa kwedatha kubonise ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) kwaba yisici esibalulekile ekuhlonze izesekeli ze-heart failure. Ukukhishwa kwe-LVEF okuncane kakhulu kwahambisana nokuphila okuncane.

samples.src: Baqale baqoqa, babala futhi bakhomba amakhizane ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini ukuze baqhathanise inani lamakhizane athwala amagciwane esifo senhliziyo kwamanye amakhizane.
samples.ref: They first collected, counted and identified ticks from cattle, sheep and goats to compare the number of ticks carrying the heartwater parasite to other ticks.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphinde baxoxisana nabanye abalimi mayelana nolwazi lwabo ngesifo senhliziyo, futhi baqoqa imibiko yesifo senhliziyo evela ehhovisi lezilwane (impilo yezilwane).
samples.ref: The researchers also interviewed some farmers on their experiences with heartwater, and collected some heartwater reports from the veterinary (animal health) office.
samples.hyp: Abacwaningi basebenzise uhlelo lwe-GIS (Uhlelo Lwemikhakha Yamahlelo) ukuhlaziya ukusatshalaliswa kwesifo senhliziyo ezifundeni ezihlukene.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathe amakhizane ayingozi ayesabalele endaweni yocwaningo, kanti isibalo sesifo senhliziyo senyuka sisuka komunye unyaka siya komunye.
samples.ref: The researchers said the harmful ticks were widespread in the study area, and that the number of heartwater disease cases increased from one year to the next.

samples.src: Baqoqe amakhizane angama-310 phakathi kowezi-2017 nowezi-2019.
samples.ref: They collected 310 ticks between 2017 and 2019.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwama-DNA kwabonisa ukuthi amakhizane angama-27 ayefana, kodwa angama-33 ayefana kuphela ngamanye amapharamitha. Ukuhlaziywa kwama-RNA kwabonisa ukuthi amakhizane angama-29 ayefana, kodwa angama-31 ayefana kuphela ngamanye amapharamitha.

samples.src: Bathola izinhlobo ezi-3 zamakhizane: amakhizane aseNingizimu Afrika, ikhizane elinemilenze emide, kanye nekhizane lenja elinsundu.
samples.ref: They found 3 types of ticks: the South African bont tick, the bont-legged tick, and the brown dog tick.
samples.hyp: Bathole ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-chromosomal level, kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-microsatellite, kungasetshenziswa ukuhlukanisa izinhlobo ezintsha.

samples.src: Evame kakhulu kwakuyikhizane laseNingizimu Afrika (85%), futhi ilona eliphethe amagciwane abangela isifo senhliziyo.
samples.ref: The most common was the South African bont tick (85%), and this is the one that carries the bacteria that causes heartwater disease.

samples.src: Ezinye izinhlobo ezi-2 zamakhizane abazihlonzile azithinteki esifweni senhliziyo, kodwa zixhunyaniswa nezinye izifo zemfuyo njenge ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ kanye ne ‘babesiosis’.
samples.ref: The other 2 types of tick they identified do not contribute to heartwater disease, but are linked to other livestock diseases like ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ and ‘babesiosis’.

samples.src: Indawo abacwaningi abayicwaningile ihlanganise i-Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, kanye no-Jwaneng.
samples.ref: The area that the researchers studied covered Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, and Jwaneng.
samples.hyp: Lezi zindawo zitholakala ebusukwini bephrofensi le-North West.

samples.src: Amakhizane abegcwele e-Goodhope, Kanye nase-Moshupa.
samples.ref: Ticks were more abundant in Goodhope, Kanye and Moshupa.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwama-genome kwama-sample avela kulezi zindawo zibonise ukuthi kunamabhulokhi amaningi afanayo, kodwa futhi kunamabhulokhi ahlukene. Lokhu kungase kubonise ukuthi kunamakhizane amaningi ahlukene kulezi zindawo. Ukuhlaziywa okwengeziwe kudingeka ukuqinisekisa lokhu.

samples.src: Lezi zindawo zazinomswakama kakhulu, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
samples.ref: These areas were mostly moist, rocky and had more vegetation.
samples.hyp: I-locus yamanzi ayisetshenzisiwe yaba yindawo ebalulekile yezilwane eziningi.

samples.src: I-Jwaneng, eyayinesibalo esincane samakhizane, yayomile, inesihlabathi futhi inezitshalo ezincane.
samples.ref: Jwaneng, which had the least number of ticks, was rather dry, sandy and had less vegetation.
samples.hyp: I-Kalahari, ngakolunye uhlangothi, yayingumhlambi omkhulu wemvelo, enezitshalo eziningi, izilwane eziningi, kanye namandla amakhulu. Ukuhlukahluka okubalulekile kwemvelo kwalesi zindawo kwabangela ukuthi izinhlobo eziningi zempilo zifanele ukuhlaziywa.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi odokotela bezilwane aveze ukuthi angama-42 izibalo zesifo senhliziyo e-Goodhope, ama-38 e-Jwaneng, ama-75 e-Kanye, ayi-146 e-Moshupa, kusukela ngowezi-2017 kuya kowezi-2019.
samples.ref: The researchers said veterinary records revealed a total of 42 cases of heartwater in Goodhope, 38 in Jwaneng, 75 in Kanye, and 146 in Moshupa, from 2017 to 2019.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathe isifo senhliziyo sathinta izimbuzi nezinkomo zakuleli ngaphezu kwezakwamanye amazwe.
samples.ref: The researchers said heartwater affected local goats and cattle breeds more than breeds from other countries.

samples.src: Bathe abalimi benza imizamo ethile yokulawula amakhizane.
samples.ref: They said farmers made some efforts to control ticks.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, ukutholakala kwayo kungenye yezinkinga ezinkulu ebangela ukwehla kokukhiqizwa kwezimoto. Ngakho-ke, ukutholakala kwayo kudinga ukulungiswa okuyisikhathi.

samples.src: Isibonelo, ama-63% abalimi bacwilisa izilwane kwizibulala-zinambuzane (amakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ukubulala izinambuzane njengamakhizane).
samples.ref: For example, 63% of farmers dipped the animals in pesticides (chemicals used to kill pests like ticks).

samples.src: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (30%) yabalimi bagcoba imfuyo yabo ngamafutha ukuze balawule amakhizane, kanti abanye (7%) baphendukela ekwakheni izibaya ezintsha.
samples.ref: About one third (30%) of the farmers applied grease to their animals to control the ticks, while others (7%) resorted to building new kraals.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi u-44% wabalimi abakaze benze lutho ukubhekana nesilwane okusolakala ukuthi siyagula, u-15% uthe uzoya kovakashela odokotela bezilwane ukuze bathole izeluleko, kodwa bazinikeze imithi ngokwabo.
samples.ref: The researchers also found that 44% of farmers did not do anything to deal with a suspected sick animal, while 15% said they would visit veterinary officers for advice, but gave medicine to the animals themselves.

samples.src: Yize wawukhona umgomo otholakalayo wokuvikela isifo senhliziyo, abacwaningi bathi u-93% wabalimi abazange bawusebenzise.
samples.ref: Even though there was a vaccine available to prevent heartwater disease, the researchers said 93% of the farmers did not use it.

samples.src: Abalimi batshele abacwaningi ukuthi yingoba abazange bafundiswe ngomgomo, nangenxa yokuthi babengakwazi ukuthenga umgomo.
samples.ref: Farmers told the researchers that it was because they were not educated about the vaccine, and because they could not afford the vaccine.

samples.src: Olunye ucwaningo olwedlule lubheka ukuthi amakhizane asatshalaliswa kanjani e-Afrika, okuhlanganisa ne-Botswana, kodwa ngokwabacwaningi, olwabo yilo olwaqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwamakhizane nesifo senhliziyo  e-Botswana.
samples.ref: Other studies in the past looked at how ticks were distributed in Africa, including Botswana, but according to the researchers, theirs was the first to look at the relationship between ticks and heartwater cases in Botswana.

samples.src: Bathe izibalo zenhliziyo eziqoshwa ngodokotela bezilwane kungenzeka abe mancane kunezimo zangempela ezitholwa abalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola isifo senhliziyo kuphela lapho isilwane sesifile, okusho ukuthi izilwane ezinalesi sifo noma izilwane ezilulamayo azijwayelekile njalo kubalwa.
samples.ref: They said the cases of heartwater recorded by veterinary doctors might actually be less than the actual cases experienced by farmers, because veterinary doctors usually only test for heartwater disease when an animal has died, meaning that animals living with the disease or animals that recovered are not always counted.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlola okwengeziwe kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola okwamanje kukhona.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bancome ukuthi abalimi kumele bafundiswe ukuthi bangasilawula kanjani futhi balawule isifo senhliziyo emfuyweni yabo, ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo waso endaweni.
samples.ref: The researchers recommended that farmers should be educated on how to control and manage heartwater disease in their livestock, so as to reduce its burden in the area.

samples.src: Baphinde bathi kumele kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuze kubhekwe izinto eziholela ekutheni imikhaza ichume.
samples.ref: They also said more research should be done to determine factors that lead to the thriving of ticks.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bebezinze e-Botswana.
samples.ref: The researchers were based in Botswana.
samples.hyp: Bahlanganise amasampula ezilonda ezivela kubafundi abangu-100 abatholakale benesifo esibucayi se-TB. Ukuhlaziywa kwe-genomic kwezansi kwe-TB kwabonisa ukuthi ukuguqulwa okuyisisekelo okuyimodeli ye-TB yaba yinto ehlukile kakhulu ezilongweni ezivame ukuba nezifo ezibucayi.

samples.src: Izithiyo Zokuhlolwa Kwendawo Yokunakekela eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika
samples.ref: Barriers to Point of Care Testing in India and South Africa
samples.hyp: : Ukuhlaziywa Kwezithiyo Zokuhlolwa Zokutholwa Kwe-Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kanye nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ezindaweni ezihlukene ze-India neNingizimu Afrika. Ucwaningo olulandelayo luhlose ukuhlaziya ukuthi ukutholakala kwe-MRSA kuthinta kanjani izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ezihlukene.

samples.src: Ukuhlolelwa Endaweni Yokunakekelwa (POC) emiphakathini, ezindaweni zasekhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo kukholakala ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekwehliseni ukubambezeleka ekuxilongeni nasekuqaliseni ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinjenge-HIV, isifo sofuba, ugcunsula, nomalaleveva.
samples.ref: Point of care (POC) testing in communities, home settings, and primary healthcare centers is believed to have tremendous potential in reducing delays in diagnosing and initiating treatment for diseases such as HIV, tuberculosis, syphilis, and malaria.

samples.src: Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo kanye nezinqumo ezengeziwe zokuphatha eziphothulwe ekuhlanganeni okufanayo komtholampilo noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngenkathi isiguli sisalindile, sithembisa ukunqoba ukubambezeleka okuhlobene nokuhlolwa okuvamile okusekelwe elabhorethri.
samples.ref: Quick diagnosis and further management decisions completed in the same clinical encounter or at least the same day, while the patient waits, promise to overcome delays associated with conventional laboratory-based testing.

samples.src: Kodwa-ke, ukutholakala kokuhlolwa okushibhile, okulula, futhi okusheshayo okungenziwa ngaphandle kwama-labhorethri akuqinisekisi ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuhlolwa kwe-POC okuphumelelayo.
samples.ref: However, the availability of cheap, simple, and rapid tests that can be conducted outside laboratories does not automatically ensure successful POC testing.

samples.src: Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselele amathuluzi ezokwelapha afana nalokhu kuhlangana, sidinga ukucwaninga ukuthi ukuxilonga kusetshenziswa kanjani ku-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe ekuhambeni komsebenzi nezindlela zesiguli.
samples.ref: In order to understand the new roles and challenges medical devices such as these encounter, we need to study how diagnostics are used at the POC and integrated into workflow and patient pathways.
samples.hyp: Ukucwaninga okunjalo kufanele kuhlanganise ukuhlaziywa kwezindlela zokusebenza, ukuhlaziywa kwezindlela zokusebenza, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezindlela zokusebenza.

samples.src: Lesi sahluko sibuyekeza imiphumela ekhethiwe evela kuphrojekthi yocwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu ngezithiyo ekuhlolweni kwe-POC e-India naseNingizimu Afrika futhi sixoxa ngayo ngokuqhathanisa.
samples.ref: This chapter reviews selected results from a qualitative research project on barriers to POC testing in India and South Africa and discusses them comparatively.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC (Point-of-Care) kubalulekile ekunwetshweni kwezokwelapha, ngoba kunikeza ukutholakala okusheshayo nezibuyekezo ezifanele ezivivinyweni zezempilo.

samples.src: Le phrojekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingahleliwe kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu ukuze kuhlolwe izindlela zokuxilonga kuzo zonke izifo ezinkulu kanye nabalingisi emakhaya, emitholampilo, emiphakathini, ezibhedlela, nasemalabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
samples.ref: The project used semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions to examine diagnostic practices across major diseases and actors in homes, clinics, communities, hospitals, and laboratories in South Africa and India.

samples.src: Ekuqhathaniseni imiphumela ekhethiwe, kuyacaca ukuthi omabili amazwe anezinhlelo zokuxilonga ezihluke kakhulu ezihlinzeka ngezimo ezihluke kakhulu zokuhlolwa kwe-POC.
samples.ref: In comparing selected results, it becomes clear that both countries have very different diagnostic eco-systems that provide very different conditions for POC testing.

samples.src: Isahluko siphetha ngokucabangisisa ngendlela yokucabangela imininingwane enjalo lapho kuklanywa izinhlelo zokuhlola ze-POC.
samples.ref: The chapter concludes by reflecting on how to take such insights into account when designing POC testing programs.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kufanele kuhlanganise nokuhlaziywa kokuhlaziywa kwesimo, ukuhlaziywa kokuhlaziywa kwesimo, kanye nokuhlaziywa kokuhlaziywa kwesimo.

samples.src: Ukuhlola kwezindawo zokunakekela okungekuhle eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kubambezela ukunakekelwa kwezempilo
samples.ref: Poor point-of-care testing in South Africa and India delays healthcare
samples.hyp: ezifanele, okubangela ukuthi abantu abaningi bagule noma bashone.

samples.src: INdawo yokunakekela (POC) ibhekisela ekuhlolweni kokunakekelwa kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isiguli sithola khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuba kuthunyelwe amasampula esiguli endaweni yokucwaninga ukuze ahlolwe.
samples.ref: Point-of-care (POC) refers to healthcare tests that are done in the same place where the patient receives care, rather than sending patient samples away to a laboratory for testing.

samples.src: INingizimu Afrika ne-India abalethi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nangempumelelo ngenxa yezinhlelo zabo ezingezinhle ze-POC namalebhu.
samples.ref: South Africa and India don’t deliver fast and efficient testing because of their poor POC systems and labs.

samples.src: Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuthi zikwazi ukufinyelela ekuhlolweni okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
samples.ref: POC testing allows patients to have access to fast testing with quick results for the treatment and management of diseases.

samples.src: Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini eshibhile futhi elula enganikeza imiphumela yokuhlolwa ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuhambisa amasampula kumalebhu.
samples.ref: This can be done with relatively cheap and simple machines that can give test results quickly without having to take the samples to labs.

samples.src: Kodwa kunezinselelo eziningi ku-POC ezinciphisa ukunakekelwa kweziguli eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
samples.ref: But there are many challenges in POC that slow down patient care in South Africa and India.
samples.hyp: Lezi zindlela zokuhlaziywa zivame ukuba nezindleko eziphezulu, zidinga ukulungiswa okuyisimiso, futhi zivame ukuthi zidinge ukutholakala kwezikhungo ezikhethekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthi ukuhlaziywa kungenziwa ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu kungaba yinkinga, ngoba ukulinda imiphumela kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni ukwelashwa kuqale ngokushesha.

samples.src: Ababhali babefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika nase-India ukuze babone izinkinga.
samples.ref: The authors wanted to compare POC testing in South Africa and India so that they could identify problems.

samples.src: Babambe izingxoxo nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zemishini yezokwelapha kusukela ngoMandulo, 2012, kuya kuNhlangulana, 2013, kuwo omabili la mazwe.
samples.ref: They held interviews and group meetings with healthcare workers, patients and medical device companies from September, 2012, to June, 2013, in both countries.

samples.src: Babuze ngezinqubo nezinkinga ze-POC.
samples.ref: They asked about POC processes and problems.
samples.hyp: Abadokotela baphinde bathathe ubuningi bezinsuku ezintathu zokuqeqeshwa, ngakho-ke, ukutholakala kwabo kwaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuhlaziywa kwama-sample kwathathwa izinsuku eziningi, okwathinta kakhulu ukuthi ngabe ukuhlolwa kwakwenzeka ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukutholakala kwezinto ezidingekayo, njenge-reagents, kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba eziningi zazo zidinga ukugcinwa kuma-freezer angatshisi. Ukuguqulwa kwedatha kwaba yinkinga, njengoba abaningi abaqeqeshiwe ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanele.

samples.src: Ekunakekelweni kwezempilo komphakathi, i-India isebenzisa amalebhu amancane amaningi futhi yenza izivivinyo eziyisisekelo, kodwa amalebhu abo awanikezwa imali eyanele, ngakho awanazo izinto ezanele zokwenza ukuhlolwa.
samples.ref: In public healthcare, India uses multiple small labs and do basic tests, but their labs are not given enough money, so they don’t have enough materials to do the testing.

samples.src: Iziguli zivame ukutshelwa ukuthi zibuye ngolunye usuku noma ziye kwenye indawo, okubangela izinkinga ezigulini.
samples.ref: Patients are often told to come back on another day or to go somewhere else, which causes problems for the patients.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphinde baqaphela ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi iziguli ziyahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi imiphumela ibuye, futhi bakuthola kunzima ukuthintana nodokotela wabo ngemva kwalokho.
samples.ref: The researchers also noticed that sometimes patients are tested but it takes long for the results to come back, and they find it hard to get in touch with their doctor afterwards.

samples.src: Abahlanganyeli bathi kufanele kube namalabhu amaningi ezibhedlela, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho kungena iziguli.
samples.ref: The participants said that there should be more labs in hospitals, and that testing could be done at the same place where patients enter.

samples.src: Baphinde bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
samples.ref: They also said that follow-ups, treatments or counselling should also happen at the same place.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuthi ukwelashwa okufanele kuthathwe kuxhomeke kakhulu ekugcineni kwesimo, hhayi ezimpawu. Ngakho-ke, ukuthi ukwelashwa okufanele kuthathwe kuxhomeke kakhulu ekugcineni kwesimo, hhayi ezimpawu.

samples.src: ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi ekunakekelweni kwezempilo komphakathi, inkampani eyodwa ephethe konke ukuhlolwa, ngakho amasampula aya kule nkampani.
samples.ref: In South Africa, they found that in public healthcare, 1 company handles all the testing, so the samples go to this company.

samples.src: Okunye ukuhlola okuyisisekelo kwenziwa endaweni yokunakekelwa, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
samples.ref: Some basic tests are done at the point of care, and the patients do get the results quickly.

samples.src: Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ne-TB kuthatha isikhathi eside ngakho-ke ukulandelela noma ukwelashwa nakho kuyabambezeleka.
samples.ref: HIV and TB tests take longer and so follow-ups or treatments are also delayed.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungabangela ukuthi abantu bangaluthole ngokushesha ukuthi banini, okungathinta kakhulu impilo yabo.

samples.src: Okunye ukubambezeleka kungenxa yezokuthutha, ukupelwa ngendlela engalungile kwamagama eziguli, ukubhalwa ngokungeyikho kwamasampula, kanye nokuwohloka kwamasistimu ekhompyutha.
samples.ref: Other delays are because of transport, incorrect spelling of patients’ names, mislabelling of samples, and the breakdown of computer systems.

samples.src: Ekuhloleni i-HIV, amanye amalebhu asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engathembekile.
samples.ref: For HIV testing, some labs used different methods of testing, and this gives unreliable results.

samples.src: Bathole ukuthi iziguli ziyazama ukuhlolelwa igciwane lengculazi ngokwebanga lendawo noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokhu kwesinye isikhathi zisebenzisa umazisi ohlukile, okudala izinkinga uma zizama ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
samples.ref: They found that patients try to get HIV testing based on the distance to the site or the type of test, and because of this they sometimes use a different identity card, which causes problems when trying to get follow-up meetings.

samples.src: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze babelane ngomsebenzi.
samples.ref: The researchers suggested that healthcare workers must work together to share the workload.

samples.src: Bathe uma kungena izinsiza ezintsha zokuhlolela igciwane lengculazi kumele abasebenzi baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi nezinhlelo kumele zilungiswe.
samples.ref: They said when new HIV testing kits come in, workers should be re-trained and that systems must be updated.

samples.src: Ababhali baqhathanise ingcobelelo ye-POC evela emazweni omabili futhi baphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele zibheke i-POC kahle ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo emisha noma amadivayisi.
samples.ref: The authors compared the POC data from both countries and they suggested that authorities must look at POC properly before adding new products or devices.

samples.src: Baphinde bathi kumele kwenziwe umzamo omkhulu ekubhekaneni nenqwaba yomsebenzi emalebhu kanye nokuqonda indima edlalwa isiguli ekunakekelweni kwaso kwezempilo.
samples.ref: They also said more effort needs to be put into dealing with the workloads in the labs and understanding the role that a patient plays in their own healthcare.

samples.ref: On the issue of death and recovery, some definitions implied that all critically ill patients would eventually die, while others implied a chance that the patient would recover despite being critically ill.

samples.ref: In the end, the researchers suggested defining critical illness as an illness where body organs stopped working, where there was a high chance that the patient would die if they were not well taken care of, but with a possibility of recovering.

samples.ref: They said critical care could even be provided in general wards, in small health facilities, in the community or in ambulances.

samples.ref: They said even in poorer set-ups, very sick patients needed critical care.

samples.ref: Researchers thus proposed that critical care could be defined as all the care that patients with critical illness got right from the time they visit healthcare workers for a consultation to the time they die or recover.

samples.ref: The researchers said this was the first study that gathered information on different definitions of critical illness and care, and that their results would help improve the care of people who are very ill.

samples.src: Ukuhlola kwe-CRISPR-Cas9 kuthola i-CENPJ njengomulawula umzimba onokuhleleka kwmashubhana ngesikhathi se-Plasmodium ekuthelelekeni kwesibindi
samples.ref: A genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen identifies CENPJ as a host regulator of altered microtubule organization during Plasmodium liver infection

samples.src: Ngaphambi kokuqala ngomalaleveva onezinkomba, iqanda le-plasmodium elilodwa lingena  kwe-hepatocyte lichamsele libe ama-merozoites ayisigidi, ngangxenye ngokuhamba idla izinsiza zalo ezihleli kuye.
samples.ref: Prior to initiating symptomatic malaria, a single Plasmodium sporozoite infects a hepatocyte and develops into thousands of merozoites, in part by scavenging host resources.
samples.hyp: Ngemuva kokugaya, i-merozoite ihlala kuleli selula futhi iyashabalala, iyakha ama-merozoites amaningi.  Lokhu kuqhubeka kuze kube yilapho ama-merozoites amaningi esuka kuleli selula futhi afaka ezinsulwini ezilodini.

samples.src: Sikhombisa ukuthi amashubhana omzimba azihlela ngenye indlela azungeze lesisimuncagazi (LS) esisesibindini.
samples.ref: We show that host microtubules dynamically reorganize around the developing liver stage (LS) parasite.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwe-immunohistochemistry kwakwabonisa ukuthi i-LS ibalwa kakhulu ezimpandeni zangaphakathi zombhede wamathambo, kodwa futhi yayikhona ezimpandeni zangaphandle.

samples.src: Ngokusebenzisa indlela yokuhlola i-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9, sithole abalawuli be-cytoskeleton, abe-vesicle trafficking, ER/Golgi stress ne-lipid biogenesis ezilawula ukwakheka kwe-Plasmodium LS.
samples.ref: Using a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen, we identified host regulators of cytoskeleton organization, vesicle trafficking, ER/Golgi stress and lipid biogenesis that regulate Plasmodium LS development.
samples.hyp: Ukulungiswa kulezi zinsimbi kungathuthukisa ukuguqulwa kwe-Plasmodium LS, okungase kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwelashweni kwe-malaria.

samples.src: Lezi zindlela ezintsha zokulawula ukutheleleka, okufakwa kuzo i-Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), isiholele ekuphenyeni ukuthi ama-microtubule organising centers (MTOCs) alawulwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
samples.ref: These novel regulators of infection, including Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), led us to interrogate how microtubule organizing centers (MTOCs) are regulated during infection.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukuguqulwa kwe-MTOC kungathinta ukwakhiwa kwe-spindle, okuyinto ebalulekile ekuguqulweni kweseli.

samples.src: Ama-Foci amashubhana e- γ-tubulin ahleli onqenqemeni lwesimuncagazi; ukuphela kwe-CENPJ kudlondlobalise lokhu okwenzekile nokutheleleka.
samples.ref: Foci of γ-tubulin localized to the parasite periphery; depletion of CENPJ exacerbated this re-localization and increased infection.

samples.src: Uma kuqhutshekwa, sikhombisse ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-non-centrosomal MTOC ngokuhlela ama-γ-tubulin akhuthaze ne-nucleation yamashubhana onqenqemeni lwezimuncagazi.
samples.ref: Further, we show that the Golgi acts as a non-centrosomal MTOC by organizing γ-tubulin and stimulating microtubule nucleation at the parasite periphery.

samples.src: Ngokuhlanganyela, sikhombisa ukuthi i- Plasmodium LS ibutha ama-Golgi ukuthi akhande ama-MT mediated conduits eqoqelana kwi-PVM, ukweseka lesi sigaba sokwakheka kwasesibindini.
samples.ref: Collectively, we show that the Plasmodium LS recruits the host Golgi to form MT mediated conduits along which host organelles are recruited to the PVM, to support liver stage development.

samples.src: Esikutholile kuphakamisa ukuthi ama-host targeted pharmacological inhibators angavimba ukutheleleka nge-LS.
samples.ref: Our findings suggest many host-targeted pharmacological inhibitors may inhibit LS infection.

samples.src: Ososayensi bacwaninga ukuthi umalaleveva uwagqekeza kanjani ama-cells ukuse bezokwandisa izindlela zokuwelapha
samples.ref: Scientists study how malaria hacks cells to try and expand treatment options

samples.src: Izimuncagazi eziningi zisebenzisa imisoco yabantu noma yesilwane ezihleli kuzo, ukuze zizalane.
samples.ref: Many parasites use the nutrients and resources of their human or animal host’s cells to reproduce themselves.
samples.hyp: Izimuncagazi eziningi zihlala ezindaweni ezifudumezile, njengase-Afrika, ngenxa yokuthi lezi zimo zivumele ukukhula kwazo. Kodwa-ke, izimuncagazi zingatholakala futhi ezindaweni ezibandayo, njengaseYurophu naseMelika. Izimuncagazi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekugayweni kwemvelo, njengokudla okuyisisekelo kwezilwane eziningi. Zingasetshenziswa futhi ekudleni, njengoba kunjalo ezweni lase-India, lapho zidlala indima ebalulekile ekudleni okuthiwa "jalebi".

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bakhombe izakhi zofuzo ezithize ezidlala indima ukuthelekeleni ngomalaleveza ezakheni zesibindi, okungaholela emithini evikela ukuthola umalaleveva esikhathini esizayo.
samples.ref: In this study researchers identified specific genes that play a role in malaria infections in liver cells, which could lead to new anti-malaria drug targets in future.

samples.src: Umalaleveva isifo esandile futhi esinobungozi empilweni esidalwa isimuncagazi i-Plasmodium, esitholakala ngokudliwa imiyane.
samples.ref: Malaria is a wide-spread and potentially life-threatening disease caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which is transmitted via mosquito bites.
samples.hyp: Ukugula okubandayo, ukugula, ukukhathazeka, ukulala, ukulahlekelwa kwamanzi kanye nokulahlekelwa kwamalahle, ukugula kwegazi, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, ukulala, uk

samples.src: Uma ingena emzimbeni, i-Plasmodium iya esibindini iyozalela - lesi s’khathi siyikhethelo emithini evikela ukuthola umalaleveva ngoba izinkomba zesifo sizuke zingakaveli nesifo sisuke singeke sidluliseke.
samples.ref: Upon entry into the body, Plasmodium heads straight for the liver to reproduce - this early stage is ideal for antimalarial treatment because there are no disease symptoms yet and the disease can’t be transmitted.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna izinguquko ezithize ezakheni zofuzo nakumaphrotheni  ezakheni zesibindi ezithelelekile, ezingashintsha indlela isifo esikhula ngayo.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to find specific changes to genes and proteins in infected liver cells that can change how an infection develops.

samples.src: Ukusebenzisa i-CRISPR-Cas9 ubuchwepheshe ubuguqula izakhi zofuzo, abacwaningi bakwaze ukucima izakhi zofuzo ezithize ukuze babone kushintshani uma lezo zakhi zingasebenzi.
samples.ref: Using the gene-editing technology CRISPR-Cas9, the researchers were able to deactivate or “knockout” specific genes to see what changes when those genes are inactive.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kusiza ukufunda ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ziba nesiphetho esithile emzimbeni.

samples.src: Babe sebethelela izakhi zofuzo zesibindi eziphilayo nezingaphili ngezimuncagazi zamalaleveva.
samples.ref: They then infected both normal and “knocked out” liver cells with malaria parasites.

samples.src: Lezi zinto ezisamashubu zibandakanyeka ezintweni eziningi okubalwa kuzo, ukuhambisa imisoco nokunye ezakheni zomzimba, futhi zijwayele ukwakhela kwi-nucleus yesakhi.
samples.ref: These tube-like structures are involved in, among other things, the movement of nutrients and materials inside cells, and they usually form a network around the cell nucleus.

samples.src: Okutholwe kuhamba phambili ukuthi i-Plasmodium izuma lamashubhana ezakhini - zesibindi esikhundleni sokuthi aqoqelane ngaphandle kwe-nucleus ezihambisa imisoco lapho edingwa izakhi khona, amashubhu aqoqelana ngaphandle kwezimuncagazi ziziphe imisoco yokuzalela.
samples.ref: One of the key findings is that Plasmodium hijacks the microtubules in liver cells - instead of the microtubules clustering around the nucleus delivering nutrients and materials to where the cell needs it, the microtubules cluster around the parasite delivering nutrients and materials to help the parasite reproduce.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuguqulwa okuyisisekelo kwe-Plasmodium, okuyilokho okuyinto ekhuthazayo, kungase kuthuthukise ukuguqulwa kwe-mitochondria.

samples.src: Abacwaningi babone ukuthi uma bewisa iphrotheni ebizwa nge-CENPJ, isimuncagazi sikwaze ukuqoqela amashubhana amaningi kuso, izimucagazi zakhula kakhulu zaziphindaphinda kakhulu.
samples.ref: Researchers saw that when they knocked out a protein called CENPJ, the parasite became very successful at gathering microtubules around itself, and the parasites grew larger and made more copies of themselves.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bokhombe ezinye izakhi ezinomthelela ekutheni ukuthelelwa i-plasmodium kuba kubi kanjani.
samples.ref: The scientists also identified several other genes that affect how severe a plasmodium infection becomes.
samples.hyp: I-plasmodium yisikhunta esibangela ukugula okubizwa ngokuthi i-malaria. Ukutholakala kwalesi sifundo kukhombisa ukuthi ukuguqulwa okungafani okukhulu kakhulu okutholwe kwi-Plasmodium falciparum, okuyisikhunta esibangelwa kakhulu i-malaria emhlabeni, kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni ukuthelelwa kuleli khunta kubi kanjani.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bake bakhombisa ngaphambilini ukuthi ezinye izimuncagazi zihlela amashubhana ukujikisa izinsiza ezisezakhini zize kuzona.
samples.ref: Researchers previously showed that other parasites reorganize microtubules to redirect resources within the cell to themselves.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinsiza ezikhona zivame ukuba zifane kakhulu futhi zifanele ukusetshenziswa. Ngakho-ke, ukuthi izimuncagazi zihlale ezindaweni ezifanayo kungase kube ngenxa yefani lezinsiza.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baqinisekise ukuthi izimuncagazi ze-Plasmodium zingasebenzisa lendlela ukujikisa imisoco ukuze zizikhulise zona.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers confirmed that Plasmodium parasites may also use this strategy to redirect nutrients and other resources for their own development.

samples.src: Esikhathini esizayo, ososayensi bathembele ekusebenziseni ukuqonda kwabo ngendlela izakhi zofuzo nezimuncagazi ezisebenzisana ngayo ngaphakathi ukuze kukhonjwe imithi emisha kamalaleveva.
samples.ref: In the future, scientists hope to use their understanding of how genes and parasites interact inside cells to identify new treatments for malaria.

samples.src: Yize abacwaningi bekhombe ezinye izinguquko ezakheni zamaphrotheni esibindi ngesikhathi umalaleveva usanda kungena, kusadingeka umsebenzi omkhulu ukuqonda ukuthi i-Plasmodium iyiguqula kanjani i-cell chemistry nokusebenza ukuze kutholakale izinto izingaqondwa imithi.
samples.ref: Although researchers identified some interesting changes in liver cell proteins during the early stages of malaria, much more work is needed to understand exactly how Plasmodium changes cell chemistry and function so that specific targets for drugs can be identified.

samples.src: Kusashona amakhulu ezinkulungwane zabantu ngonyaka ngenxa kamalaleveva, izibalo ezinkulu zalokhu zise-Afrika.
samples.ref: Hundreds of thousands of deaths still occur each year from malaria, with a large number of these in Africa.
samples.hyp:
Ukutholakala kwezindlela ezintsha zokwelapha, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokugaya, kungcono kakhulu ukwelashwa kwamalaleveva. Kodwa-ke, ukuthi lezi zindlela zintsha ziwusizo kangakanani ezindaweni eziningi ezihlukene, kanye nokuthi ziwusizo kangakanani ezihlakaleni ezihlukene zabantu, akaziwa.

Translation:
Hundreds of thousands of people die each year from malaria, with the vast majority of these deaths occurring in Africa. The development of new treatments, and the improvement of diagnostic methods, have greatly improved the treatment of malaria. However, it is unknown how effective these new methods are in different regions, and how effective they are for different populations.

samples.src: Ngokwe World Health Organisation, izimo zikamalaleveva ezidlula u-90% emhlabeni wonke ngo-2019 zenzeke e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube inkinga enkulu edinga ukungenelelwa ekuyilawuleni.
samples.ref: According to the World Health Organisation, over 90% of global malaria cases in 2019 occurred in Africa, making this an important issue that requires ongoing efforts towards control and intervention.

samples.src: Ukuhlasela Kwezinto Eziphilayo Njengengxenye Yomzamo Wokucwaninga Ngezinguquko Zomhlaba waseNingizimu Afrika
samples.ref: Biological Invasions as a Component of South Africa’s Global Change Research Effort

samples.src: Kulesi sahluko, sihlola ukuthi lungakanani ucwaningo eNingizimu Afrika oluqondiswe ekuhlaselweni kwezinto eziphilayo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izici zoshintsho emhlabeni.
samples.ref: In this chapter, we assess how much research in South Africa has been directed towards biological invasions relative to other elements of global change.
samples.hyp: Sicabangela ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwe-genome kwezinto eziphilayo kungathinta kanjani ukusatshalaliswa kwazo kanye nokuhlasela izinto eziphilayo, futhi singaxwayisa ukuthi ukuguqulwa okungafani okukhulu kakhulu kungaba yindlela yokuhlonza izinhlobo ezithile zokuguqulwa kwezinto eziphilayo.

samples.src: Sisebenzisa iWebhu Yesayensi, sibuyekeze ngokuhlelekile izincwadi ezihambisana nemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika ezishicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kanye neziphathelene nokuhlasela kwebhayoloji, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa komhlaba, kanye/noma i-CO2 yomoya.
samples.ref: Using Web of Science, we systematically reviewed literature relevant to South African ecosystems published between 2000 and 2018 and relating to biological invasions, climate change, overharvesting, habitat change, pollution, and/or atmospheric CO2.

samples.src: Sihlonze amaphepha afanelekile ayi-1149 anikezwe amaphuzu ngokuya ngekhava yawo yabashayeli nokusebenzisana kwabashayeli okuthinta izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem.
samples.ref: We identified 1149 relevant papers that were scored in terms of their coverage of drivers and driver interactions that affect biodiversity or ecosystem services.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwamanani okuhlobene nezinto eziphilayo kanye nokuhlolwa kwamanani okuhlobene nezinsiza ze-ecosystem kwakuyizinqubo ezihlukene ezisetshenzisiwe.

samples.src: Umphumela oqinile we-spatio-temporal wabonwa emzamweni wocwaningo.
samples.ref: A strong spatio-temporal effect was observed on research effort.

samples.src: Okokuqala, imizamo yahluka phakathi kwezindawo, lapho ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa komhlaba kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile kwathola ucwaningo olugxile kakhulu endaweni esemhlabeni, emanzini ahlanzekile kanye nasolwandle/nezindawo zemifula ngokulandelana.
samples.ref: Firstly, effort differed between realms, with habitat change, pollution and overharvesting receiving the largest research focus within terrestrial, freshwater and marine/estuarine realms respectively.

samples.src: Okwesibili, izigigaba ezithile ezifundwe kahle emhlabeni wonke azibhalwanga ezincwadini zendawo (isb., bekunamaphepha angaphansi kwamahlanu e-acidification olwandle).
samples.ref: Secondly, certain globally well-studied phenomena were not documented in local literature (e.g. there were fewer than five papers on ocean acidification).
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa okunzulu okwamanje kungenzeka ukuthi kungabonisi ukuthi ukuguqulwa okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisibalo okuyisib

samples.src: Sihlonze ukusebenzisana okuhlukene okungu-21 phakathi kwabashayeli, nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo nokushintsha kwendawo (ngokwesibonelo imithetho eguquliwe yomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselwe) okugqama kakhulu.
samples.ref: We identified 21 different interactions between drivers, with the interactions between invasive species and habitat change (for example altered fire regimes in invaded landscapes) being the most prominent.

samples.src: Kodwa-ke, angaphansi kuka-4% wamaphepha akhulume ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.
samples.ref: However, fewer than 4% of papers addressed interactions between three or more drivers.

samples.src: Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuthi nakuba ukubaluleka kokuqonda ukusebenzisana kwabashayeli kuqashelwa, kube nencane indlela yokucwaninga imithelela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzelana kwabashayeli ezindaweni eziphilayo zaseNingizimu Afrika.
samples.ref: This suggests that while the importance of understanding driver interactions is recognised, there has been little in the way of researching the compound effects of driver interactions in South African ecosystems.

samples.src: Isitatimende esikade sicashunwa sokuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ziyingozi yesibili ngobukhulu ekongiweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zemvelo, ngemuva koshintsho lwendawo yokuhlala, sifana nomphumela wocwaningo oluhlobene nalo mshayeli eNingizimu Afrika.
samples.ref: The long-cited statement that invasive species pose the second-largest threat to biodiversity conservation, behind habitat change, matches the relative research output for this driver in South Africa.
samples.hyp: Ukukhuthazwa kokuguqulwa kwe-genome kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo, okuyimbangela enkulu yokuphunyuka kwazo, kukhuthazwe ukwengezwa kwemigomo yezinto eziphilayo, ukuguqulwa kwezimo zemvelo, kanye nokuguqulwa kwezinto eziphilayo.

samples.src: Ukuthuthukisa isithombe esiphelele sobuningi bokubaluleka okuhlobene koshintsho emhlabeni jikelele kuzoba yinselele nokho, hhayi kuphela ekuchazeni ngendlela ecacile abashayeli, kodwa nangenxa yokutholakala kokungalingani kwemiphumela yocwaningo esikalini sendawo nesesikhashana esiqhathanisekayo.
samples.ref: Developing a comprehensive quantitative picture of the relative importance of global change drivers will nonetheless be challenging, not only in the unambiguous delineation of drivers, but also due to the unequal availability of research results at comparable spatial and temporal scales.

samples.src: Ukuvuthwa okulinganiselwe komsebenzi wezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kungase kunikeze isisekelo sokuhlola ukusebenzisana okunjalo okuyinkimbinkimbi futhi ngaleyo ndlela kube nengxenye ekunqobeni leyo migoqo.
samples.ref: The relative maturity of work on invasive species could provide a basis for exploring such complex interactions and thus contribute to overcoming such barriers.

samples.src: Abacwaningi kumele benze imephu yemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yezilwane ezihlaselayo, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kanye nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika
samples.ref: Researchers must map combined effects of invasive species, climate change and human activities in South Africa
samples.hyp: ukuze bakwazi ukubona ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kungathinta kanjani ukusatshalaliswa kwazo.

samples.src: Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ziwusongo lwesibili olukhulu ekongiweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elihambisana, kusho abacwaningi, ngenani lamaphepha ocwaningo olwenziwe ngalesi sihloko.
samples.ref: Invasive species are the second biggest threat to biodiversity conservation in South Africa - a fact matched, say researchers, by the number of research papers done on the topic.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, ukuthi lezi zinhlobo ziwusongo olukhulu kangakanani, kanye nokuthi ziwusongo olukhulu kangakanani ezinhlotshana ezihlukene zendawo yaseNingizimu Afrika, akazange ucwaningwe ngokwanele.

samples.src: Lokhu kuhlobene nezinye izinsongo ezinjengokungcoliswa komhlaba, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuvunwa ngokweqile noma ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala.
samples.ref: This is relative to other threats like pollution, climate change, overharvesting or changes in habitat.

samples.src: Lezi zinsongo ezithinta imvelo yilokho ososayensi abakubiza ngokuthi abashayeli bezinguquko zomhlaba, okuwucwaningo lokuthi umhlaba, njengohlelo, ushintsha kanjani kukho konke ukuxhumana. phakathi kwezinto ezenziwa abantu nezinye izinqubo zomzimba, amakhemikhali kanye nezebhayoloji.
samples.ref: These threats to ecosystems are what scientists also call drivers of global change, which is the study of how the Earth, as a system, changes with all the interactions between human activities and other physical, chemical and biological processes.

samples.src: Esahlukweni sakamuva sencwadi, abacwaningi babheke ukuthi lungakanani ucwaningo olwenziwayo eNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuhlasela kwebhayoloji, okuyilapho izinhlobo ezinjengezitshalo noma izilwane zingeniswa endaweni entsha lapho ziyachuma, zibe namandla futhi zingalimaza ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane ezizungezile noma indawo ezungezile.
samples.ref: In a recent book chapter, researchers looked at exactly how much research is being done in South Africa on biological invasions, which is when species like plants or animals are introduced into a new area where they thrive, become established and potentially harm other surrounding species or the environment.

samples.src: Baphinde babheka ucwaningo lokuthi lo mshayeli uxhumana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.

samples.src: Bebheka emaphepheni ocwaningo ashicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kusizindalwazi se-"Web of Science", bathola izifundo ezifanele eziyi-1149.
samples.ref: Looking through research papers published between 2000 and 2018 on the “Web of Science” database, they found 1149 relevant studies.
samples.hyp: Kwalezi zifundo, abacwaningi bahlanganise idatha yezifo ezihlobene nezifo zengqondo ezifana ne-schizophrenia, i-bipolar disorder, kanye ne-major depressive disorder, kanye neminye imikhakha efana ne-neurology, i-psychiatry, kanye ne-epidemiology.

samples.src: Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kocwaningo kubonise ukuthi umhlabathi (i-terrestrial) ) ucwaningo lwalugxile kakhulu ezinguqukweni zendawo yokuhlala, kuyilapho ucwaningo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lugxile ekungcolisweni, futhi ucwaningo lwasolwandle nechweba lubheke kakhulu ukuvuna ngokweqile.
samples.ref: Their review of the studies showed that land-based (terrestrial) research focussed more on changes in habitat, while freshwater research centred on pollution, and marine and estuary research looked mostly at overharvesting.

samples.src: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izenzakalo ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle izifundo zaseNingizimu Afrika.
samples.ref: They also found that phenomena that are well-documented globally to affect biodiversity or ecosystem services, are not well-documented in local South African studies.

samples.ref: For example, they only found 5 papers looking at ocean acidification, which disrupts food chains and harms sea life.

samples.ref: This happens because excess carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, from human activities like burning fossil fuels, dissolves in seawater.

samples.ref: The authors say this suggests more research into how drivers of global change interact to affect ecosystems is needed in South Africa.

samples.ref: The South African authors acknowledge that it will be difficult to develop a full picture of how global change drivers interact in South Africa, but said existing local research on invasive species can already inform studies in this complex field.

samples.src: Ezingxenyeni ezithile zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukucwiliswa kwezitho zangasese kwabesifazane (FGM), ngezinye izikhathi okubizwa ngokuthi ‘ukusokwa kwabesifazane’, kusavame ukwenziwa.
samples.ref: In parts of Africa and Asia, female genital mutilation (FGM), which is sometimes called ‘female circumcision’, is still commonly practiced.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungenziwa ngezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa amasiko, ukukhuthazwa, kanye nokuziphatha. Kodwa-ke, ukucwiliswa kwezitho zangasese kwabesifazane kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yezempilo yabesifazane, okuhlanganisa ubuhlungu, ukugaya, kanye nokutheleleka.

samples.src: Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kube nenhlanzeko efanele noma ukugcina abesifazane benesizotha (bengenalo ize futhi bethobekile), futhi baqiniseke ukuthi bazokwazi ukuthola abantwana.
samples.ref: Many people falsely believe that FGM is necessary for proper hygiene or to keep women modest (free of vanity and humble), and to make sure they will be able to have children.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, akukho ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-FGM kanye nenhlanzeko noma ukugcinwa kwesizotha. Empeleni, i-FGM ingabangela izinkinga eziningi zobuphakathiphazama, ezempilo, nezombusazwe.

samples.src: I-FGM ayidingeki kunoma yikuphi kwalokhu ngokobufakazi besayensi.
samples.ref: FGM is not required for any of these according to scientific evidence.
samples.hyp: Ukwehliswa kwezinsilo kungabangela ukulimala okukhulu, ukugaya, kanye nokugaya okuyisimiso. Ukwehliswa kwezinsilo kungaphinde kuthinte ubukhulu bempilo yomuntu, okuhlanganisa ukugaya, ukukhubazeka, kanye nokufa.

samples.src: Ezimweni eziningi, nokho, izingane ezingaphansi kwe-FGM zigcina zinezinkinga zempilo kamuva ekuphileni, njengezifo eziyingozi, ubunzima bokuchama (ukushobinga), nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
samples.ref: In many cases, however, children subjected to FGM end up with health problems later in life, like harmful infections, difficulty urinating (weeing), and mental health issues.

samples.src: Ngenxa yokuthi lo mkhuba uyingozi futhi uhlukumeza amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi akwenze kwabe ngokungekho semthethweni, kodwa abantu basawenza ngasese.
samples.ref: Because the practice is so harmful and violates women's human rights, many countries have made it illegal, but people still do it secretly.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ngokuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi yini abantu abayikholelwayo ngalo mkhuba.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to understand more about why FGM happens in different countries, and what people believe about the practice.

samples.src: Ngakho-ke baqoqa ulwazi mayelana ne-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.
samples.ref: They therefore collected information about FGM in Kenya, Ethiopia and Indonesia.
samples.hyp: Ulwazi lolu luyisikhathi eside, luyahlukahluka, futhi luyahlanganisa izincwadi zokuhlaziya, izindatshana zencwadi, izindatshana zencwadi, izincwadi zokuhlaziya, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlaziya. Ulwazi lolu luyisikhathi eside, luyahlukahluka, futhi luyahlanganisa izincwadi zokuhlaziya, izindatshana zencwadi, izindatshana zencwadi, izincwadi zokuhlaziya, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlaziya.

samples.src: Ezweni ngalinye, abacwaningi bakhuluma nabantu ngalo mkhuba, okuhlanganisa abazali, intsha, abaholi bendabuko, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye ‘nabasokayo’ (abesifazane abadala ababevame ukwenza i-FGM emantombazaneni amancane).
samples.ref: In each country, the researchers talked to people about the practice, including parents, young people, traditional leaders, health workers, and ‘circumcisers’ (older women who used to perform FGM on young girls).

samples.src: Kwezinye izimo, baxoxisana nalaba bantu ngabanye, kodwa baphinde bakhulume namaqembu abantu, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala abasebancane kanye nentsha, abaye bahlushwa i-FGM.
samples.ref: In some cases, they interviewed these people individually, but they also spoke with groups of people, including younger adults and teenagers, who had suffered FGM.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu zeFGM, indlela okwenziwa ngayo, nezinkolelo ngalo mkhuba, zihlukene ezweni ngalinye.
samples.ref: The researchers found that the reasons for FGM, the way it was done, and beliefs about the practice, were different in each country.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi ukuthi uk

samples.src: Baphinde bathola ukuthi baningi abantu abasawenza ngisho nasezindaweni lapho ungekho semthethweni khona.
samples.ref: They also found out that many people still practised it, even in places where it was illegal.

samples.src: Isibonelo, e-Indonesia, ababelethisi bendabuko babesebenzisa ummese noma inaliti ukusika ingxenye yobhontshisi (isitho esikhulukazi esibangela injabulo yocansi kwabesifazane) lapho ingane yentombazane inezinsuku ezingu-40 ubudala.
samples.ref: For example, in Indonesia, traditional birth attendants used a knife or needle to cut part of the clitoris (the organ mostly responsible for sexual pleasure in women) when a baby girl was 40 days old.

samples.src: Abantu babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuyasiza ‘ekususeni ukungcola’ nokuthi kwakubalulekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingokwenkolo.
samples.ref: People believed this helped to ‘remove impurities’ and that it was important for religious reasons.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlanzwa kwamanzi kwaba yingxenye ebalulekile yezinto ezibalulekile ezifana nokuthanda nokuhlonipha.

samples.src: E-Ethiopia, i-FGM yenzeke ngisho nangaphambi kwalokho, ngezinye izikhathi lapho izingane zinezinsuku ezingu-7 kuphela ubudala.
samples.ref: In Ethiopia, FGM happened even earlier, sometimes when babies were only 7 days old.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abantu bakhona babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izoba ‘inkosikazi enhle’ ngelinye ilanga, nokuthi izolalela, futhi ingabi nobudlova kumyeni wayo.
samples.ref: The researchers found out that people there believed this would ensure the girl would be a ‘good wife’ one day, and that she would be obedient, and not aggressive to her husband.

samples.src: Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi i-FGM yenza ukubeletha kube lula kodwa empeleni kungakwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuzala.
samples.ref: Many people also believed FGM made childbirth easier but it can actually make it more difficult to give birth instead.
samples.hyp: I-FGM ingadala ubuhlungu obukhulu, ukohlisayo, kanye nokulahlekelwa kokugeleza kwegazi ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Kungase futhi kudale ukutheleleka, ukulimala, kanye nokulahlekelwa kwe-uterus.

samples.src: Phakathi naleso sikhathi eKenya, i-FGM yayibonisa ukuthi intombazane isifinyelele ebufazini, futhi kwakuvame ukwenzeka kade ekuphileni, lapho iseyintsha.
samples.ref: Meanwhile in Kenya, FGM signalled that a girl had reached womanhood, and it usually happened later in life, when she was a teenager.

samples.src: Kwezinye izimo, nokho, bathola ukuthi amantombazane angakwazi ukwenza i-FGM esemancane kusukela eminyakeni engu-8 ubudala, nokuthi amantombazane amaningi agcina ekhulelwe esemasha, ngoba ayebhekwa njengabantu abadala ngokwanele ocansini ngemuva kwe-FGM.
samples.ref: In some cases, however, they found that girls could undergo FGM as young as 8 years old, and that many girls ended up pregnant as teenagers, because they were considered old enough for sex after FGM.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi abakutholile kukhombisa ukuthi ziningi izizathu ezenza ukuthi isenzeka.
samples.ref: The researchers say that their findings show there are many different reasons that FGM still happens.
samples.hyp: Okukhulu kunazo zonke, ukuthi ukukhubazeka kwengqondo okuyisibalo esikhulu kakhulu kuye kwatholakala ezinsheni eziningi, okuyikhambi elitholakala ezitolo.

samples.src: Njengoba imithetho nemibono yezenhlalo ishintsha, ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani futhi kuphi nakho kuyashintsha.
samples.ref: As laws and social ideas change, how and where it gets done also changes.
samples.hyp: Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa okujulile kokuqonda kwabantu ngalokho okwamanje okubonakala njengokungafaneleka kwezinto ezithile, kanye nokuziphatha okuhambisana nalokho, kubalulekile.

samples.src: Ngokwesibonelo, abazali bangase bazame ukukwenza ngasese nakuba kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kudingekile ukuba indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.
samples.ref: For example, parents may try and get it done secretly even though it’s illegal, because they think it’s necessary for their daughter to be healthy or find a good husband.
samples.hyp: Kodwa-ke, lokhu kungabangela ukuthi abantwana bathathe izinqumo ezingalungile, njengokushaya izimpahla, ukuthenga okungafanele, noma ukuziphatha okungafanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abazali nabo nabo nentsha baye ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhula okuzinzile.

samples.src: Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi i-FGM ayikho emthethweni kwezinye izindawo, ukucwaninga ngesihloko kungase kube nzima, futhi abantu bangase banganikezi njalo izimpendulo eziyiqiniso mayelana nesihloko.
samples.ref: It’s important to realise that because FGM is illegal in some places, researching the topic can be difficult, and people might not always give truthful answers about the subject.

samples.src: Esikhathini esizayo, ngaphezu kokwenza kube semthethweni, abacwaningi bathi ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele bahlose ukumisa i-FGM ngokubhekana nezinkolelo ezingamanga abantu abanazo ngalo mkhuba futhi babafundise ngezingozi.
samples.ref: In the future, in addition to making it illegal, the researchers say governments and health authorities should aim to stop FGM by addressing the false beliefs people have about the practice and educating them on the dangers.

samples.src: Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi base-Ethiopia, Indonesia kanye ne-Netherlands, futhi luyingxenye yohlelo olukhulu, olubizwa nge-‘Yebo ngiyavuma”, okuhloswe ngalo ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwentsha, umshado wezingane kanye ne-FGM.
samples.ref: This study was a collaboration between scientists from Ethiopia, Indonesia and the Netherlands, and forms part of a bigger project, called the ‘Yes I Do programme’, whicht aims to reduce teen pregnancies, child marriage and FGM.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ezikhungweni zempilo ezingu-10 ezindaweni ezihlukene zeDolobha lase-Addis Ababa, ngabantu abangu-600 abathathwe ngokusondela. Ababambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo bathwetshulwa ngolimi lwesi-Amharic, ngokusetshenziswa kwezifundo ezilandelayo: i-demographic, izinto ezibalulekile zempilo, ukuziphatha, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile zokukhulelwa.

samples.src: Ukungalingani Kwama-Hormone Enzalo, I-Germ Cell Apoptosis, I-Sperm Morphophenotypes Engavamile kanye Nezinguquko Ezinhle Kakhulu Kumagundane Amakhulu Ase-Afrika (Cricetomys gaambianus, Waterhouse, 1840) Echayeke Ku-Sodium Metavanadate Ukudakwa
samples.ref: Reproductive Hormones Imbalance, Germ Cell Apoptosis, Abnormal Sperm Morphophenotypes and Ultrastructural Changes in Testis of African Giant Rats (Cricetomys gambianus, Waterhouse, 1840) Exposed to Sodium Metavanadate Intoxication
samples.hyp: Kwe-Ova.

samples.src: Ukuchayeka kwemvelo ku-vanadium bekulokhu kukhuphuka muva nje.
samples.ref: Environmental exposure to vanadium has been on the increase in recent time.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlaziywa kwamanani okuchayeka kwe-vanadium ezimbonini ezihlukene kubonisa ukuthi ukuchayeka okukhulu kakhulu kwenzeka ezimbonini zokutshala, ezokudoba, kanye nezimboni zokukhiqiza amachweba. Ukuchayeka kwe-vanadium kungaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezempilweni kanye nezimo yezulu.

samples.src: Le nsimbi iwubuthi obaziwayo.
samples.ref: This metal is a known toxicant.

samples.src: Ucwaningo lwamanje lwenziwe ukuze kuphenywe ubuthi bokuzala be-sodium metavanadate (SMV) kumagundane angama-giant Afrika.
samples.ref: The current study was conducted to investigate the reproductive toxicity of sodium metavanadate (SMV) in male African giant rats.
samples.hyp: Izinhlamvu eziningi zama-SMV ezahlukene zahlolwa, futhi kwatholakala ukuthi ukukhishwa kwebhayoloji kwe-SMV kunomthelela omkhulu ekukhuliseni amagundane.

samples.src: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-SMV kwenziwa nge-intraperitoneally nsuku zonke izinsuku ezingu-14 ezilandelanayo ngesilinganiso se-3 mg/kg isisindo somzimba.
samples.ref: Administration of SMV was done intraperitoneally daily for 14 consecutive days at a dosage of 3mg/kg body weight.

samples.src: Amanzi angenalutho anikezwe iqembu lokulawula.
samples.ref: Sterile water was administered to the control group.
samples.hyp: Izinga lokukhuthazwa kwegesi eliphakanyisiwe kwakuyi-20% yegesi yomoya. Izinga lokukhuthazwa kwegesi eliphakanyisiwe lilinganiselwe ngamathani angama-20 ngosuku. Izinga lokukhuthazwa kwegesi eliphakanyisiwe lilinganiselwe ngamathani angama-600 ngenyanga.

samples.src: Sihlaziye amahomoni okuzala e-serum, ukugcinwa kwesidoda kanye nekhwalithi kanye nezinguquko ze-ultrastructural yamasende ngemva kokwelashwa kwe-SMV.
samples.ref: We analyzed serum reproductive hormones, sperm reserve and quality as well as testicular ultrastructural changes following SMV treatment.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa kwe-PCR kwakufakwa ukuhlukanisa izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-SMV. Ukuhlolwa kwe-ELISA kwakusetshenziselwa ukuthola izinga le-prolactin. Ukuhlolwa kwe-flow cytometry kwakusetshenziselwa ukuhlaziya ukuguqulwa kwe-apoptosis kanye nokuguqulwa kwe-necrosis.

samples.src: Imiphumela yethu ibonise ukuthi iqembu le-SMV elidaluliwe le-AGR lalikhuphule i-progesterone ngokwezibalo kodwa lehla ukugxila kwe-testosterone, i-FSH ne-LH.
samples.ref: Our results showed SMV exposed AGR group had statistically increased progesterone but decreased testosterone, FSH and LH concentrations.

samples.src: Futhi, iqembu elilashwa nge-SMV liye lehle ngokwezibalo ukuhamba kwesidoda kanye nomsebenzi omkhulu ngamaphesenti andayo e-morphophenotypes engavamile ye-spermatozoa kanye nokulawulwa kwe-P53 immunopositive cell.
samples.ref: Also, SMV treated group had statistically decreased sperm motility and mass activity with increased percentage of abnormal morphophenotypes of spermatozoa and upregulation of P53 immunopositive cell.

samples.src: Ucwaningo lwe-Ultrastructural lwembula i-vocuolation yegciwane kanye namaseli e-Sertoli, i-cytoplasmic ne-nucleus; kanye nokuvuvukala kwe-mitochondrial kanye nokukhishwa kwe-vacuols nakho kwabonwa.
samples.ref: Ultrastructural study revealed vocuolation of germ and Sertoli cells, cytoplasmic and nucleus; and mitochondrial swelling and vacuolations were also observed.

samples.src: Kube nokuhlakazeka okukhulu kwamashubhu eseminiferous, i-atrophy kanye nokuwohloka kwamaseli e-myeloid kanye ne-apoptosis ye-Leydig, i-Sertoli namaseli amagciwane.
samples.ref: There was severe disintegration of the seminiferous tubules, atrophy and degeneration of myeloid cells and apoptosis of the Leydig, Sertoli and germ cells.

samples.src: Sengiphetha, ukuchayeka kwe-intraperitoneal SMV kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu kwamanye amahomoni okuzala e-serum, ukunciphisa ukugcinwa kwesidoda kanye nekhwalithi, i-apoptosis kanye nezinguquko eziwohlokayo ze-Leydig, i-Sertoli namangqamuzana amagciwane okungaholela ekungazali.
samples.ref: In conclusion, intraperitoneal SMV exposure exerts severe adverse effects on some serum reproductive hormones, reduction of sperm reserve and quality, apoptosis and degenerative changes of the Leydig, Sertoli and germ cells which can lead to infertility.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi insimbi etholakala emoyeni ongcolile yenza amagundane angabi nabantwana
samples.ref: Researchers say metal found in polluted air makes rats infertile
samples.hyp: . Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi insimbi ibanga ukukhishwa kwezicubu zokuzala ezinkulu ezifana ne-estrojeni ne-progesterone, ezibalulekile ekukhuliseni nokuhlaliswa kweziguli.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi i-vanadium, uhlobo lwensimbi, ilimaza amangqamuzana amagundane kanye nekhono lawo lokudala inzalo (ukuzala).
samples.ref: Researchers found that vanadium, a type of metal, damages rats’ cells and their ability to create offspring (fertility).
samples.hyp: Okwengeziwe, bathola ukuthi ukuchayeka kwe-vanadium kungabangela ukukhubazeka kwe-DNA.

samples.src: Ngenxa yokuthi le nsimbi iphinde ibe nobuthi kubantu, baphakamisa ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze bathole ukuthi insimbi, etholakala ngokwandayo endaweni esizungezile ngenxa yokungcola, ingaba nemiphumela emibi efanayo yini empilweni yomuntu.
samples.ref: Because this metal is also toxic to humans, they suggest more research to find out if the metal, which is increasingly found in our environment due to pollution, might have similar negative effects on human health.

samples.src: Ngisho noma i-vanadium iyinsimbi, ingangena emoyeni ngamanani amancane lapho kushiswa amafutha, njengamafutha namalahle.
samples.ref: Even though vanadium is a metal, it can enter the air in tiny amounts when fossil fuels, like oil and coal, are burned.
samples.hyp: Lokhu kungabangela ukuthi i-vanadium ibe yingxenye yomdlavuza. Ukutholakala kwayo emithonjeni yamanzi kungaba yinkinga, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziywa okuchaze ukuthi i-vanadium ingafakwa kanjani emithonjeni yamanzi kufanele kwenziwe.

samples.src: Njengoba umhlaba usebenzisa okuningi kwale mithombo kaphethiloli, inani lokunukubezeka kwe-vanadium liyakhula.
samples.ref: As the world uses more of these fuel sources, the amount of vanadium pollution increases.
samples.hyp: Ukunukubezeka kwe-vanadium kungabangela ukuthi kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu kanye nezinto ezibukhoma. Ngakho-ke, ukuhlaziywa okujulile kwamanani e-vanadium ezimeni ezihlukene zendalo kuyadingeka.

samples.src: Siyazi vele ukuthi abantu abachayeka kuyo bangaba nezinkinga zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, umphimbo owomile namehlo, nezinhlungu esifubeni.
samples.ref: We already know that people exposed to it can suffer from health problems like anaemia, dry throats and eyes, and chest pains.
samples.hyp: Ukwengeza, ukuchayeka kulezi zinto kungathinta ukusebenza kweglikogiprothini, okungabangela ukwehliswa kwezigceme.

samples.src: Muva nje, ososayensi baye baba nesithakazelo emiphumeleni i-vanadium engaba nayo ekuzaleni.
samples.ref: Recently, scientists have also become interested in the effects that vanadium could have on fertility.
samples.hyp: Ukuhlolwa okudlule kwabonisa ukuthi ukugaya kwe-vanadium kungathinta ukukhiqizwa kwe-testosterone emikhakheni yobudoda. Ngakho-ke, ucwaningo olusha oluqondene nokuhlaziywa kwemiphumela yalesi siliva ekuzaleni kufanele kuqaliswe.

samples.src: Sebeqalile ukufunda le miphumela kumagundane, avame ukusetshenziswa elabhorethri ngenxa yokufana kwawo nabantu.
samples.ref: They’ve started to study these effects in rats, which are often used in the laboratory because of their similarity to humans.

samples.src: Kulolu cwaningo, ososayensi babenesithakazelo emiphumeleni ye-vanadium ohlotsheni oluvamile lwegundane elitholakala eNtshonalanga Afrika, elibizwa ngokuthi i-African Giant Rat.
samples.ref: In this study, the scientists were interested in the effects of vanadium on a common type of rat found in West Africa, called the African Giant Rat.
samples.hyp: Bahlosile ukuhlola ukuthi ukugwetshwa kwe-vanadium kuleli gundane kungathinta kanjani impilo yalo. Ngokukodwa, bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ukugwetshwa kwe-vanadium kungathinta kanjani ukugaya, ukukhula, kanye nokuziphatha kwalezi zidalwa. Ukwengeza, babefuna ukuhlola ukuthi ukugwetshwa kwe-vanadium kungathinta kanjani ukukhishwa kwe-hormone kanye nokusebenza kwe-enzyme.

samples.src: Babefuna ukuqonda ukuthi i-vanadium ishintsha kanjani izinhlelo zokuzala zamagundane wesilisa, ikakhulukazi isidoda sabo, amahomoni, namaseli amasende abo.
samples.ref: They wanted to understand how vanadium changes male rat reproductive systems, specifically their sperm, hormones, and the cells of their testicles.

samples.src: Abacwaningi bajova amagundane abesilisa angu-6 nge-vanadium kanye ngosuku, izinsuku ezingu-14.
